entries.text: It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to 14 interpretations of what happened. When work started again on Monday, output 16 rose compared with the previous Saturday and 17 to rise for the next couple of days. 18, a comparison with data for weeks when there was no experimentation showed that output always went up on Mondays. Workers 19 to be diligent for the first few days of the week in any case, before 20 a plateau and then slackening off. This suggests that the alleged "Hawthorne effect" is hard to pin down. entries.title: It is indicated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 that ___.
entries.text: It is indicated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 that ___. [A] arts criticism has disappeared from big-city newspapers 艺术评论已从大都市报纸上消失 [B] English-language newspapers used to carry more arts reviews [C] high-quality newspapers retain a large body of readers 高质量报纸保有一大批读者 [D] young readers doubt the suitability of criticism on dailies 年轻读者怀疑日报评论的恰当性 答案 B It is indicated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 that ___.第 1 段和第 2 段表明___。 [A] arts criticism has disappeared from big-city newspapers艺术评论已从大都市报纸上消失 [B] English-language newspapers used to carry more arts reviews [C] high-quality newspapers retain a large body of readers高质量报纸保有一大批读者 [D] young readers doubt the suitability of criticism on dailies年轻读者怀疑日报评论的恰当性 💡 考场思路首段说 arts coverage 的 scope 和 seriousness 在 inexorable decline（不可阻挡地衰落），第二段说过去大城市报上能读到高质量评论——反推：过去报纸有更多艺术评论。 逐项分析 [A] 艺术评论已从大报消失 → 偷换，原文是 decline 不是 disappeared； [B] 英文报过去有更多艺术评论 → 正确，decline 反推过去更多； [C] 高质量报纸仍有大量读者 → 无中生有； [D] 年轻读者怀疑评论适合登日报 → 无中生有，原文是今天的人 marvel at。

entries.title: Newspaper reviews in England before World War II were characterized by ___.
entries.text: Newspaper reviews in England before World War II were characterized by ___. [A] free themes [B] casual style 随意的风格 [C] elaborate layout 精心设计的布局 [D] radical viewpoints 激进的观点 答案 A Newspaper reviews in England before World War II were characterized by ___.二战前英格兰的报纸评论以___为特征。 [A] free themes [B] casual style随意的风格 [C] elaborate layout精心设计的布局 [D] radical viewpoints激进的观点 💡 考场思路第三段首句 unfocused newspaper reviews = 没有固定焦点、主题自由的评论。unfocused ≈ free themes。 逐项分析 [A] 主题自由 → 正确，unfocused 同义替换； [B] 风格随意 → 与 serious business 相反； [C] 版面精美 → 偷换，原文说 stylish criticism 是 ornament 不是 layout； [D] 激进观点 → 无中生有。

entries.title: Which of the following would Shaw and Newman most probably agree on?
entries.text: Which of the following would Shaw and Newman most probably agree on? [A] It is writers' duty to fulfill journalistic goals. 实现新闻目标乃作家之责。 [B] It is contemptible for writers to be journalists. 作家充当记者是卑劣的。 [C] Writers are likely to be tempted into journalism. 作家很可能被诱惑进入新闻业。 [D] Not all writers are capable of journalistic writing. 答案 D Which of the following would Shaw and Newman most probably agree on?Shaw和Newman最有可能同意以下哪一项？ [A] It is writers' duty to fulfill journalistic goals.实现新闻目标乃作家之责。 [B] It is contemptible for writers to be journalists.作家充当记者是卑劣的。 [C] Writers are likely to be tempted into journalism.作家很可能被诱惑进入新闻业。 [D] Not all writers are capable of journalistic writing. 💡 考场思路纽曼原话："So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism"——有足够头脑和天赋把新闻做好的作家太少。= 并非所有作家都能胜任新闻写作。

entries.title: What can be learned about Cardus according to the last two paragraphs?
entries.text: What can be learned about Cardus according to the last two paragraphs? [A] His music criticism may not appeal to readers today. [B] His reputation as a music critic has long been in dispute. 他作为乐评人的声誉长期存在争议。 [C] His style caters largely to modern specialists. 他的风格主要迎合现代专家。 [D] His writings fail to follow the amateur tradition. 他的著作未能遵循业余传统。 答案 A What can be learned about Cardus according to the last two paragraphs?根据最后两段，关于Cardus可以学到什么？ [A] His music criticism may not appeal to readers today. [B] His reputation as a music critic has long been in dispute.他作为乐评人的声誉长期存在争议。 [C] His style caters largely to modern specialists.他的风格主要迎合现代专家。 [D] His writings fail to follow the amateur tradition.他的著作未能遵循业余传统。 💡 考场思路最后一段：postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered prose he specialized in——后现代读者对他的华丽文风不感兴趣。= 他的音乐评论可能对今天的读者没有吸引力。

entries.title: What would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: What would be the best title for the text? [A] Newspapers of the Good Old Days 昔日美好的报纸 [B] The Lost Horizon in Newspapers [C] Mournful Decline of Journalism 新闻业的哀歌式衰落 [D] Prominent Critics in Memory 记忆中的著名批评家 答案 B What would be the best title for the text?这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？ [A] Newspapers of the Good Old Days昔日美好的报纸 [B] The Lost Horizon in Newspapers [C] Mournful Decline of Journalism新闻业的哀歌式衰落 [D] Prominent Critics in Memory记忆中的著名批评家 💡 考场思路全文讲报纸艺术评论衰落、评论家被遗忘。B"报纸中逝去的地平线"既指过去的辉煌又指失落，最贴合。C范围过大（全文只讲 arts criticism，不是整个 journalism）。 核心词汇 inexorable adj. 不可阻挡的 coverage n. 新闻报道 marvel at 惊叹 deem v. 认为 calling n. 使命/职业 upholstered adj. 辞藻华丽的 headlong retreat 急速衰落 save to 除……之外

entries.title: Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of ___.
entries.text: Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of ___. [A] their limited value to businesses. 它们对企业的有限价值。 [B] their connection with asset allocation. 它们与资产配置的关联。 [C] the possible restriction on their granting. [D] the controversy over their authorization. 围绕其授权的争议。 答案 C Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of ___.商业方法专利最近因___而引起关注。 [A] their limited value to businesses.它们对企业的有限价值。 [B] their connection with asset allocation.它们与资产配置的关联。 [C] the possible restriction on their granting. [D] the controversy over their authorization.围绕其授权的争议。 💡 考场思路第二段首句 ready to scale back on business-method patents——准备缩减商业方法专利。scale back = restrict。题干 recently 对应 now。 逐项分析 [A] 对企业价值有限 → 与文中企业竞相申请相反； [B] 与资产配置相关 → 只是例子； [C] 授权可能受限 → 正确； [D] 授权争议 → 偷换，controversy 是10年来一直有，但 recently 引起关注是因为法院要限制。

entries.title: Which of the following is true of the Bilski case?
entries.text: Which of the following is true of the Bilski case? [A] Its ruling complies with the court decisions. 其裁决符合法院判决。 [B] It involves a very big business transaction. 它涉及一笔巨大的商业交易。 [C] It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit. 它已被联邦巡回法院驳回。 [D] It may change the legal practices in the U.S. 答案 D Which of the following is true of the Bilski case?对于Bilski案，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] Its ruling complies with the court decisions.其裁决符合法院判决。 [B] It involves a very big business transaction.它涉及一笔巨大的商业交易。 [C] It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit.它已被联邦巡回法院驳回。 [D] It may change the legal practices in the U.S. 💡 考场思路第二段说 It has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents——可能撤销一整类专利，即改变美国法律实践。

entries.title: The word "about-face" (Para. 3) most probably means ___.
entries.text: The word "about-face" (Para. 3) most probably means ___. [A] loss of goodwill. 商誉的损失。 [B] increase of hostility. 敌意的增强。 [C] change of attitude. [D] enhancement of dignity. 尊严的提升。 答案 C The word "about-face" (Para. 3) most probably means ___.“about-face”（第 3 段）一词最可能的意思是___。 [A] loss of goodwill.商誉的损失。 [B] increase of hostility.敌意的增强。 [C] change of attitude. [D] enhancement of dignity.尊严的提升。 💡 考场思路about-face 原义"向后转"。联邦巡回法院1998年引入这类专利，现在又要限制——态度180度大转弯。

entries.title: We learn from the last two paragraphs that business-method patents ___.
entries.text: We learn from the last two paragraphs that business-method patents ___. [A] are immune to legal challenges. 不受法律挑战影响。 [B] are often unnecessarily issued. [C] lower the esteem for patent holders. 降低对专利持有人的尊重。 [D] increase the incidence of risks. 增加风险发生的几率。 答案 B We learn from the last two paragraphs that business-method patents ___.我们从最后两段中了解到，商业方法专利___。 [A] are immune to legal challenges.不受法律挑战影响。 [B] are often unnecessarily issued. [C] lower the esteem for patent holders.降低对专利持有人的尊重。 [D] increase the incidence of risks.增加风险发生的几率。 💡 考场思路最后一段：too many patents were being upheld for "inventions" that are obvious——太多显而易见的"发明"被授予专利。= 很多专利其实不该发。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the subject of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the subject of the text? [A] A looming threat to business-method patents. [B] Protection for business-method patent holders. 对商业方法专利持有人的保护。 [C] A legal case regarding business-method patents. 一起关于商业方法专利的诉讼。 [D] A prevailing trend against business-method patents. 反对商业方法专利的一种普遍趋势。 答案 A Which of the following would be the subject of the text?以下哪一项是本文的主题？ [A] A looming threat to business-method patents. [B] Protection for business-method patent holders.对商业方法专利持有人的保护。 [C] A legal case regarding business-method patents.一起关于商业方法专利的诉讼。 [D] A prevailing trend against business-method patents.反对商业方法专利的一种普遍趋势。 💡 考场思路全文讲法院准备缩减商业方法专利，这是"即将到来的威胁"。注意D说 prevailing trend（已盛行），但文章说法院刚要行动、威胁尚未完全落地，looming（隐约逼近）更准。 核心词汇 patent n. 专利 scale back 缩减 controversial adj. 有争议的 authorize v. 授权 eliminate v. 消除 about-face n. 大转弯 stake out 主张/声称 hedge risk 对冲风险

entries.title: By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to ___.
entries.text: By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to ___. [A] analyze the consequences of social epidemics. 分析社会流行的后果。 [B] discuss influentials' function in spreading ideas. [C] exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics. 例证人们对社会潮流的直觉反应。 [D] describe the essential characteristics of influentials. 描述有影响力者的本质特征。 答案 B By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to ___.通过引用《引爆点》一书，作者打算___。 [A] analyze the consequences of social epidemics.分析社会流行的后果。 [B] discuss influentials' function in spreading ideas. [C] exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics.例证人们对社会潮流的直觉反应。 [D] describe the essential characteristics of influentials.描述有影响力者的本质特征。 💡 考场思路首段引用《引爆点》提出"有影响力者推动社会潮流"这一观点，然后全文讨论这个观点对不对。引用是为了引出有影响力者在传播观念中的作用这一话题。

entries.title: The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory" ___.
entries.text: The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory" ___. [A] serves as a solution to marketing problems. 充当营销难题的一种解决方案。 [B] has helped explain certain prevalent trends. 有助于解释某些流行趋势。 [C] has won support from influentials. 已赢得有影响力人士的支持。 [D] requires solid evidence for its validity. 答案 D The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory" ___.作者提出“两步流理论” ___。 [A] serves as a solution to marketing problems.充当营销难题的一种解决方案。 [B] has helped explain certain prevalent trends.有助于解释某些流行趋势。 [C] has won support from influentials.已赢得有影响力人士的支持。 [D] requires solid evidence for its validity. 💡 考场思路第二段说该理论是 plausible-sounding but largely untested（听起来合理但基本未经验证），最后一句 anecdotal evidence（传闻证据）——暗示需要可靠证据。

entries.title: What the researchers have observed recently shows that ___.
entries.text: What the researchers have observed recently shows that ___. [A] the power of influence goes with social interactions. [B] interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media. 人际关系可通过媒体得到加强。 [C] influentials have more channels to reach the public. 有影响力者拥有更多触达公众的渠道。 [D] most celebrities enjoy wide media attention. 多数名人享有广泛的媒体关注。 答案 A What the researchers have observed recently shows that ___.研究人员最近观察到的情况表明___。 [A] the power of influence goes with social interactions. [B] interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media.人际关系可通过媒体得到加强。 [C] influentials have more channels to reach the public.有影响力者拥有更多触达公众的渠道。 [D] most celebrities enjoy wide media attention.多数名人享有广泛的媒体关注。 💡 考场思路研究发现潮流靠层层人际影响传播：每个人影响熟人，熟人再影响熟人。影响力伴随社会互动而传递。

entries.title: The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who ___.
entries.text: The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who ___. [A] stay outside the network of social influence. 置身于社会影响网络之外。 [B] have little contact with the source of influence. 与影响源几乎无接触。 [C] are influenced and then influence others. [D] are influenced by the initial influential. 受初始有影响力者的左右。 答案 C The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who ___.第4款中带下划线的短语“这些人”指的是___的人。 [A] stay outside the network of social influence.置身于社会影响网络之外。 [B] have little contact with the source of influence.与影响源几乎无接触。 [C] are influenced and then influence others. [D] are influenced by the initial influential.受初始有影响力者的左右。 💡 考场思路these people 指代前一句：each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs——那些被影响又反过来影响别人的人。

entries.title: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?
entries.text: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence? [A] The eagerness to be accepted. 渴望被接纳。 [B] The impulse to influence others. 影响他人的冲动。 [C] The readiness to be influenced. [D] The inclination to rely on others. 依赖他人的倾向。 答案 C What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?社会影响力动态的基本要素是什么？ [A] The eagerness to be accepted.渴望被接纳。 [B] The impulse to influence others.影响他人的冲动。 [C] The readiness to be influenced. [D] The inclination to rely on others.依赖他人的倾向。 💡 考场思路末句：a critical mass of easily influenced people——一大批容易受影响的人。easily influenced = readiness to be influenced。 核心词汇 epidemic n. 流行病/潮流 influential n. 有影响力者 compelling adj. 令人信服的 plausible adj. 貌似合理的 cursory adj. 粗略的 cascade n. 连锁反应 propagate v. 传播 critical mass 临界数量

entries.title: Bankers complained that they were forced to ___.
entries.text: Bankers complained that they were forced to ___. [A] follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules. [B] collect payments from third parties. 向第三方收取费用。 [C] cooperate with the price managers. 与价格管理者合作。 [D] re-evaluate some of their assets. 重新评估其部分资产。 答案 A Bankers complained that they were forced to ___.银行家们抱怨说，他们被迫___。 [A] follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules. [B] collect payments from third parties.向第三方收取费用。 [C] cooperate with the price managers.与价格管理者合作。 [D] re-evaluate some of their assets.重新评估其部分资产。 💡 考场思路首段：准则迫使银行按第三方愿意支付的价格评估资产（price managers/regulators 想让它们按高价算），银行抱怨不公平。即被迫遵守不利的资产评估规则。

entries.title: According to the author, the rule changes of the FASB may result in ___.
entries.text: According to the author, the rule changes of the FASB may result in ___. [A] the diminishing role of management. 管理作用的弱化。 [B] the revival of the banking system. 银行体系的复苏。 [C] the banks' long-term asset losses. 银行的长期资产损失。 [D] the weakening of its independence. 答案 D According to the author, the rule changes of the FASB may result in ___.据作者称， FASB的规则变更可能会导致___。 [A] the diminishing role of management.管理作用的弱化。 [B] the revival of the banking system.银行体系的复苏。 [C] the banks' long-term asset losses.银行的长期资产损失。 [D] the weakening of its independence. 💡 考场思路第二段说准则制定者独立性正在受损；第三段FASB在国会压力下匆匆改规则——即独立性被削弱。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to ___. [A] keep away from political influences. 远离政治影响。 [B] evade the pressure from rule-makers. 逃避规则制定者的压力。 [C] act on their own in rule-setting. [D] take gradual measures in reform. 在改革中采取渐进措施。 答案 C According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to ___.根据第4段， McCreevy反对国际会计准则理事会试图___。 [A] keep away from political influences.远离政治影响。 [B] evade the pressure from rule-makers.逃避规则制定者的压力。 [C] act on their own in rule-setting. [D] take gradual measures in reform.在改革中采取渐进措施。 💡 考场思路IASB想"在没有整体规划下不贸然行动"即按自己节奏独立行事；McCreevy警告它"不是生活在政治真空中"——反对它独断专行。

entries.title: The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they ___.
entries.text: The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they ___. [A] misinterpreted market price indicators. 误读了市场价格指标。 [B] exaggerated the real value of their assets. [C] neglected the likely existence of bad debts. 忽视了坏账可能存在。 [D] denied booking losses in their sale of assets. 否认在资产出售中存在账面亏损。 答案 B The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they ___.作者认为银行“在错误的星球上” ，因为他们___。 [A] misinterpreted market price indicators.误读了市场价格指标。 [B] exaggerated the real value of their assets. [C] neglected the likely existence of bad debts.忽视了坏账可能存在。 [D] denied booking losses in their sale of assets.否认在资产出售中存在账面亏损。 💡 考场思路第五段首句：It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets——银行账目严重高估资产。overvalued = exaggerated the real value。

entries.title: The author's attitude towards standard-setters is one of ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude towards standard-setters is one of ___. [A] satisfaction. 满意；满足。 [B] skepticism. 怀疑；质疑。 [C] objectiveness. 客观。 [D] sympathy. 答案 D The author's attitude towards standard-setters is one of ___.作者对标准制定者的态度是___之一。 [A] satisfaction.满意；满足。 [B] skepticism.怀疑；质疑。 [C] objectiveness.客观。 [D] sympathy. 💡 考场思路末段说 successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters，又说它们giving in to critics是在招致压力——作者同情被银行游说施压的准则制定者。 核心词汇 take aim at 瞄准/批评 moan v. 抱怨 compromise v. 损害 toxic assets 不良资产 illiquid adj. 非流动的 book value 账面价值 combative adj. 好斗的 concession n. 让步

entries.text: Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect that insects would eat us up if birds failed to control them. Those forced to exercise their smiling muscles 18 more enthusiastically to funny cartoons than did those whose mouths were contracted in a frown, 19 that expressions may influence emotions rather than just the other way around. 20, the physical [A] Eventually 最终 [B] Consequently 因此 [C] Similarly 类似地 [D] Conversely 相反地 💡 考场思路表情影响情绪（微笑使人开心），"类似地"，笑这个身体动作也能改善情绪。并列类比。 ⚠️ 完形总结本文讲笑与情绪的关系，核心实验是斯特拉克咬笔实验。考点：逻辑关系（1/6/13/20）+ 动词辨析（2/3/4/8/9/14/16/18/19）+ 介词搭配（12 in/15 from）。

entries.title: We learn from Paragraph 1 that Gilbert's appointment has ___.
entries.text: We learn from Paragraph 1 that Gilbert's appointment has ___. [A] incurred criticism. 招致批评。 [B] raised suspicion. 引发了怀疑。 [C] received acclaim. [D] aroused curiosity. 引发了好奇心。 答案 C We learn from Paragraph 1 that Gilbert's appointment has ___.我们从第1段中得知，吉尔伯特的任命有___。 [A] incurred criticism.招致批评。 [B] raised suspicion.引发了怀疑。 [C] received acclaim. [D] aroused curiosity.引发了好奇心。 💡 考场思路第一段：the response has been favorable（反应是正面的），评论家写道"Hooray! At last!"（好哇！终于！）。favorable = acclaim（赞扬）。

entries.title: Tommasini regards Gilbert as an artist who is ___.
entries.text: Tommasini regards Gilbert as an artist who is ___. [A] influential. 有影响力的。 [B] modest. [C] respectable. 体面的；可敬的。 [D] talented. 有天赋的。 答案 B Tommasini regards Gilbert as an artist who is ___.Tommasini认为Gilbert是一位___的艺术家。 [A] influential.有影响力的。 [B] modest. [C] respectable.体面的；可敬的。 [D] talented.有天赋的。 💡 考场思路第二段：unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor——谦逊、没有架子。unpretentious = modest。

entries.title: The author believes that the devoted concertgoers ___.
entries.text: The author believes that the devoted concertgoers ___. [A] ignore the expenses of live performances. 忽视现场演出的开支。 [B] reject most kinds of recorded performances. 拒绝大多数录制的演出。 [C] exaggerate the variety of live performances. 夸大现场演出的多样性。 [D] overestimate the value of live performances. 答案 D The author believes that the devoted concertgoers ___.作者认为，忠诚的音乐会观众___。 [A] ignore the expenses of live performances.忽视现场演出的开支。 [B] reject most kinds of recorded performances.拒绝大多数录制的演出。 [C] exaggerate the variety of live performances.夸大现场演出的多样性。 [D] overestimate the value of live performances. 💡 考场思路第四段说这些人认为唱片不能替代现场，但作者说唱片便宜、随处可得、艺术品质往往更高——即这些忠实乐迷"高估了"现场演出的价值。

entries.title: Which of the following is true of recordings?
entries.text: Which of the following is true of recordings? [A] They are often inferior to live concerts in quality. 它们在质量上常逊于现场音乐会。 [B] They are easily accessible to the general public. [C] They help improve the quality of music. 它们有助于提高音乐质量。 [D] They have only covered masterpieces. 它们只涵盖了杰作。 答案 B Which of the following is true of recordings?对于录音，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] They are often inferior to live concerts in quality.它们在质量上常逊于现场音乐会。 [B] They are easily accessible to the general public. [C] They help improve the quality of music.它们有助于提高音乐质量。 [D] They have only covered masterpieces.它们只涵盖了杰作。 💡 考场思路第四段：cheap, available everywhere, can be consumed at a time and place of the listener's choosing——便宜、随处可得、可自选时间地点。= 大众容易获得。

entries.title: Regarding Gilbert's role in revitalizing the Philharmonic, the author feels ___.
entries.text: Regarding Gilbert's role in revitalizing the Philharmonic, the author feels ___. [A] doubtful. [B] enthusiastic. 热情的。 [C] confident. 自信的。 [D] puzzled. 困惑的。 答案 A Regarding Gilbert's role in revitalizing the Philharmonic, the author feels ___.关于吉尔伯特在振兴爱乐乐团方面的作用，作者感到___。 [A] doubtful. [B] enthusiastic.热情的。 [C] confident.自信的。 [D] puzzled.困惑的。 💡 考场思路末段：But what will be the nature of that difference? Merely expanding the orchestra's repertoire will not be enough——作者连用两个反问/否定，暗示对吉尔伯特能否振兴乐团持怀疑态度。 核心词汇 philharmonic n. 爱乐乐团 favorable adj. 赞许的 unpretentious adj. 谦逊的 formidable adj. 令人敬畏的 orchestra n. 管弦乐队 repertoire n. 全部曲目 vibrant adj. 充满活力的 revitalize v. 使复兴

entries.title: When McGee announced his departure, his manner can best be described as being __
entries.text: When McGee announced his departure, his manner can best be described as being ___. [A] arrogant. 傲慢的。 [B] frank. [C] self-centered. 以自我为中心的。 [D] impulsive. 冲动的。 答案 B When McGee announced his departure, his manner can best be described as being ___.当McGee宣布离开时，他的举止最好被描述为___。 [A] arrogant.傲慢的。 [B] frank. [C] self-centered.以自我为中心的。 [D] impulsive.冲动的。 💡 考场思路首段：explanation was surprisingly straight up（直白），Rather than cloaking... came right out（没有掩饰、直截了当）。straight up/come right out = frank。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 2, senior executives' quitting may be spurred by ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 2, senior executives' quitting may be spurred by ___. [A] their expectation of better financial status. 他们对更好财务状况的期待。 [B] their need to reflect on their private life. 他们反思私人生活的需要。 [C] their strained relations with the boards. 他们与董事会的紧张关系。 [D] their pursuit of new career goals. 答案 D According to Paragraph 2, senior executives' quitting may be spurred by ___.根据第2段，高级管理人员的辞职可能受到___的刺激。 [A] their expectation of better financial status.他们对更好财务状况的期待。 [B] their need to reflect on their private life.他们反思私人生活的需要。 [C] their strained relations with the boards.他们与董事会的紧张关系。 [D] their pursuit of new career goals. 💡 考场思路第二段：they were looking for a CEO post（在找CEO职位）+ aspirations（抱负）。高管辞职是为了追求新职业目标。

entries.title: The word "poached" (Paragraph 4) most probably means ___.
entries.text: The word "poached" (Paragraph 4) most probably means ___. [A] approved of. 赞成；认可。 [B] attended to. 得到照料；被处理。 [C] hunted for. [D] guarded against. 被防范；受到防备。 答案 C The word "poached" (Paragraph 4) most probably means ___.“偷猎”一词（第4款）最有可能意味着___。 [A] approved of.赞成；认可。 [B] attended to.得到照料；被处理。 [C] hunted for. [D] guarded against.被防范；受到防备。 💡 考场思路后句说董事会总是让猎头"look at sitting CEOs first"——即去挖现任CEO。poach = 挖人、物色。

entries.title: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ___. [A] top performers used to cling to their posts. [B] loyalty of top performers is getting out-dated. 顶尖者的忠诚正在过时。 [C] top performers care more about reputations. 顶尖者更看重声誉。 [D] it's safer to stick to the traditional rules. 遵循传统规则更安全。 答案 A It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ___.从最后一段可以推断出___。 [A] top performers used to cling to their posts. [B] loyalty of top performers is getting out-dated.顶尖者的忠诚正在过时。 [C] top performers care more about reputations.顶尖者更看重声誉。 [D] it's safer to stick to the traditional rules.遵循传统规则更安全。 💡 考场思路末段：The traditional rule was it's safer to stay where you are——过去的规则是待在原地更安全，言下之意过去高管坚守岗位。这一规则现已被颠覆。

entries.title: Which of the following is the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following is the best title for the text? [A] CEOs: Where to Go? 首席执行官们：路在何方？ [B] CEOs: All the Way Up? 首席执行官们：一路向上？ [C] Top Managers Jump without a Net [D] The Only Way Out for Top Performers 顶尖者的唯一出路 答案 C Which of the following is the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] CEOs: Where to Go?首席执行官们：路在何方？ [B] CEOs: All the Way Up?首席执行官们：一路向上？ [C] Top Managers Jump without a Net [D] The Only Way Out for Top Performers顶尖者的唯一出路 💡 考场思路全文核心：高管们在没有下家（without a net）的情况下裸辞，去追求CEO职位。C既点出"高管"又点出"裸辞无安全网"这一现象。 核心词汇 depart v. 离职 cloak v. 掩饰 board n. 董事会 scrutinize v. 仔细审查 succession n. 继任 turbulent adj. 动荡的 poach v. 挖人 invert v. 颠覆

entries.title: Consumers may create "earned" media when they are ___.
entries.text: Consumers may create "earned" media when they are ___. [A] obsessed with online shopping at certain Web sites. 沉迷于在某些网站网购。 [B] inspired by product-promoting e-mails sent to them. 受到发给他们的产品推广邮件的启发。 [C] eager to help their friends promote quality products. 热衷于帮朋友推销优质产品。 [D] enthusiastic about recommending their favorite products. 答案 D Consumers may create "earned" media when they are ___.消费者可以在___时创建“赚取”媒体。 [A] obsessed with online shopping at certain Web sites.沉迷于在某些网站网购。 [B] inspired by product-promoting e-mails sent to them.受到发给他们的产品推广邮件的启发。 [C] eager to help their friends promote quality products.热衷于帮朋友推销优质产品。 [D] enthusiastic about recommending their favorite products. 💡 考场思路首段：Consumers passionate about a product may create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends——酷爱某产品的消费者自愿向朋友推荐。passionate = enthusiastic。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 2, sold media feature ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 2, sold media feature ___. [A] a safe business environment. 安全的商业环境。 [B] random competition. 随机竞争。 [C] strong user traffic. [D] flexibility in organization. 组织的灵活性。 答案 C According to Paragraph 2, sold media feature ___.根据第2段，已售媒体功能___。 [A] a safe business environment.安全的商业环境。 [B] random competition.随机竞争。 [C] strong user traffic. [D] flexibility in organization.组织的灵活性。 💡 考场思路第二段：We define such sold media as owned media whose traffic is so strong that other organizations place their content...——售出媒体的特征是流量巨大。

entries.title: The author indicates in Paragraph 3 that earned media ___.
entries.text: The author indicates in Paragraph 3 that earned media ___. [A] invite constant conflicts with passionate consumers. 招致与狂热消费者的持续冲突。 [B] can be used to produce negative effects in marketing. [C] may be responsible for fiercer competition. 可能导致更激烈的竞争。 [D] deserve all the negative comments about them. 配得上对它们的所有负面评价。 答案 B The author indicates in Paragraph 3 that earned media ___.作者在第3段中指出赢得了媒体___。 [A] invite constant conflicts with passionate consumers.招致与狂热消费者的持续冲突。 [B] can be used to produce negative effects in marketing. [C] may be responsible for fiercer competition.可能导致更激烈的竞争。 [D] deserve all the negative comments about them.配得上对它们的所有负面评价。 💡 考场思路第三段：hijacked media are the opposite of earned media——赢得媒体可能被劫持，变成对企业不利的负面宣传。

entries.title: Toyota Motor's experience is cited as an example of ___.
entries.text: Toyota Motor's experience is cited as an example of ___. [A] responding effectively to hijacked media. [B] persuading customers into boycotting products. 说服客户抵制产品。 [C] cooperating with supportive consumers. 与支持型消费者合作。 [D] taking advantage of hijacked media. 利用被劫持的媒体。 答案 A Toyota Motor's experience is cited as an example of ___.丰田汽车的经验被引用为___的一个例子。 [A] responding effectively to hijacked media. [B] persuading customers into boycotting products.说服客户抵制产品。 [C] cooperating with supportive consumers.与支持型消费者合作。 [D] taking advantage of hijacked media.利用被劫持的媒体。 💡 考场思路末段：丰田通过快速、精心策划的社交媒体应对活动减轻了召回危机损失——这是对被劫持媒体的有效应对。

entries.title: Which of the following is the text mainly about?
entries.text: Which of the following is the text mainly about? [A] Alternatives to conventional paid media. [B] Conflict between hijacked and earned media. 被劫持媒体与赢得媒体之间的冲突。 [C] Dominance of hijacked media. 被劫持媒体的主导。 [D] Popularity of owned media. 自有媒体的流行。 答案 A Which of the following is the text mainly about?以下哪项是本文的主要内容？ [A] Alternatives to conventional paid media. [B] Conflict between hijacked and earned media.被劫持媒体与赢得媒体之间的冲突。 [C] Dominance of hijacked media.被劫持媒体的主导。 [D] Popularity of owned media.自有媒体的流行。 💡 考场思路首段主题句：companies today can exploit many alternative forms of media——除传统付费媒体外还有赢得媒体、自有媒体、售出媒体、被劫持媒体等多种形式。 核心词汇 exploit v. 利用 leverage v. 充分利用 alternative n. 替代选择 initiator n. 发起者 traffic n. 流量 hijack v. 劫持 allegation n. 指控 alleviate v. 减轻

entries.title: Jennifer Senior suggests in her article that raising a child can bring ___.
entries.text: Jennifer Senior suggests in her article that raising a child can bring ___. [A] temporary delight. 暂时的愉悦。 [B] enjoyment in progress. 过程中的享受。 [C] happiness in retrospect. [D] lasting reward. 持久的回报。 答案 C Jennifer Senior suggests in her article that raising a child can bring ___.Jennifer Senior在她的文章中建议，抚养孩子可以带来___。 [A] temporary delight.暂时的愉悦。 [B] enjoyment in progress.过程中的享受。 [C] happiness in retrospect. [D] lasting reward.持久的回报。 💡 考场思路首段：being happy as a past-tense condition + 当下沮丧的事日后成为满足喜悦之源。= 幸福是回顾时才感受到的。in retrospect = 回顾。

entries.title: We learn from Paragraph 2 that ___.
entries.text: We learn from Paragraph 2 that ___. [A] celebrity moms are a permanent source for gossip. 名人妈妈是八卦永恒的源头。 [B] single mothers with babies deserve greater attention. 带婴单亲母亲应得到更多关注。 [C] news about pregnant celebrities is entertaining. 关于怀孕名人的新闻很有趣。 [D] having children is highly valued by the public. 答案 D We learn from Paragraph 2 that ___.我们从第2段了解到___。 [A] celebrity moms are a permanent source for gossip.名人妈妈是八卦永恒的源头。 [B] single mothers with babies deserve greater attention.带婴单亲母亲应得到更多关注。 [C] news about pregnant celebrities is entertaining.关于怀孕名人的新闻很有趣。 [D] having children is highly valued by the public. 💡 考场思路第二段列了大量明星妈妈/准妈妈上杂志封面——社会如此推崇生育，以至于怀孕、带孩子是媒体追逐的焦点。

entries.title: It is suggested in Paragraph 3 that childless folks ___.
entries.text: It is suggested in Paragraph 3 that childless folks ___. [A] are constantly exposed to criticism. [B] are largely ignored by the media. 在很大程度上被媒体忽视。 [C] fail to fulfill their social responsibilities. 未能履行其社会责任。 [D] are less likely to be satisfied with their life. 更不容易对生活感到满意。 答案 A It is suggested in Paragraph 3 that childless folks ___.第3段建议无子女的人___。 [A] are constantly exposed to criticism. [B] are largely ignored by the media.在很大程度上被媒体忽视。 [C] fail to fulfill their social responsibilities.未能履行其社会责任。 [D] are less likely to be satisfied with their life.更不容易对生活感到满意。 💡 考场思路第三段：不幸福的无子女者被"孩子是世界上最重要的东西"这一讯息所困扰——社会不断向他们施压/指责。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, the message conveyed by celebrity magazines is ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, the message conveyed by celebrity magazines is ___. [A] soothing. 抚慰的；令人宽慰的。 [B] ambiguous. 模糊的；模棱两可的。 [C] compensatory. 补偿性的。 [D] misleading. 答案 D According to Paragraph 4, the message conveyed by celebrity magazines is ___.根据第4段，名人杂志传达的信息是___。 [A] soothing.抚慰的；令人宽慰的。 [B] ambiguous.模糊的；模棱两可的。 [C] compensatory.补偿性的。 [D] misleading. 💡 考场思路第四段首句：the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines present is hugely unrealistic——杂志呈现的形象极不真实。unrealistic = misleading。

entries.title: Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph?
entries.text: Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph? [A] Having children contributes little to the glamour of celebrity moms. 生孩子对名人妈妈的魅力贡献甚微。 [B] Celebrity moms have influenced our attitude towards child rearing. [C] Having children intensifies our dissatisfaction with life. 生育加剧了我们对生活的不满。 [D] We sometimes neglect the happiness from child rearing. 我们有时忽视了育儿带来的幸福。 答案 B Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph?从最后一段可以推断出以下哪项？ [A] Having children contributes little to the glamour of celebrity moms.生孩子对名人妈妈的魅力贡献甚微。 [B] Celebrity moms have influenced our attitude towards child rearing. [C] Having children intensifies our dissatisfaction with life.生育加剧了我们对生活的不满。 [D] We sometimes neglect the happiness from child rearing.我们有时忽视了育儿带来的幸福。 💡 考场思路末段：杂志上无忧无虑的妈妈形象，正以潜意识方式加剧我们对真实育儿的不满——即明星妈妈形象影响了我们对养孩子的态度。 核心词汇 provocative adj. 引发争议的 redefine v. 重新定义 fulfilling adj. 令人满足的 procreation n. 生育 equivalent adj. 等同的 glamorous adj. 光鲜的 subconscious adj. 潜意识的 dissatisfaction n. 不满

entries.title: 【题目】关于哈佛教授Louis Menand所著《思想市场：美国大学的改革与阻力》一书的书评。E、G段已就位。排序：G → 41 → 42 → 43 → E →
entries.text: 【题目】关于哈佛教授Louis Menand所著《思想市场：美国大学的改革与阻力》一书的书评。E、G段已就位。排序：G → 41 → 42 → 43 → E → 44 → 45。 答案 B 【题目】关于哈佛教授Louis Menand所著《思想市场：美国大学的改革与阻力》一书的书评。E、G段已就位。排序：G → 41 → 42 → 43 → E → 44 → 45。 匹配依据[B] 他主要关心人文学科：文学、语言、哲学等。这些学科正在过时：22%的美国大学生学商科，而历史只占2%、英语4%。但顶尖大学希望本科生接受"经典著作"基础训练……→ 承接G段"Menand捕捉到美国大学怪事"，先讲他关心的对象是人文学科。 Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G ANo disciplines have seized on professionalism with as much enthusiasm the humanities. You can, Mr. Menand points out, became a lawyer in three years and a medical doctor in four. But the regular time it takes to get a doctoral degree in the humanities is nine years. Not surprisingly, up to half of all doctoral students in English drop out before getting their degrees.没有任何学科像人文学科那样热衷于专业化。梅南德先生指出，你可以三年成为律师、四年成为医生，但人文学科拿博士学位通常要九年。无怪乎多达一半的英语专业博士生在拿到学位前就辍学了。 BHis concern is mainly with the humanities: Literature, languages, philosophy and so on. These are disciplines that are

entries.title: 【题目】关于哈佛教授Louis Menand所著《思想市场：美国大学的改革与阻力》一书的书评。E、G段已就位。排序：G → 41 → 42 → 43 → E →

[A] confirm 确认 [B] express 表达 [C] cultivate 培植/培养 [D] offer 提供 答案 C cultivate The framers of the Constitution envisioned law 10 having authority apart from politics. They gave justices permanent positions 11 they would be free to 12 those in power and have no need to 13 political support. Our legal system was designed to set law apart from politics precisely because they are so closely 14. [A] confirm 确认 [B] express 表达 [C] cultivate 培植/培养 [D] offer 提供 💡 考场思路无需"培植"政治支持。cultivate support = 拉拢支持。

entries.title: Our legal system was designed to set law apart from politics precisely because t
entries.text: Our legal system was designed to set law apart from politics precisely because they are so closely 14. [A] guarded 保卫 [B] followed 跟随 [C] studied 研究 [D] tied 联系 答案 D tied The framers of the Constitution envisioned law 10 having authority apart from politics. They gave justices permanent positions 11 they would be free to 12 those in power and have no need to 13 political support. Our legal system was designed to set law apart from politics precisely because they are so closely 14. [A] guarded 保卫 [B] followed 跟随 [C] studied 研究 [D] tied 联系 💡 考场思路be closely tied = 紧密联系。正因为法律与政治联系紧密，才要刻意分开。

entries.title: Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundam
entries.text: Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social 15 like liberty and property. [A] concepts 概念 [B] theories 理论 [C] divisions 划分 [D] conventions 惯例 答案 A concepts Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social 15 like liberty and property. When the court deals with social policy decisions, the law it 16 is inescapably political—which is why decisions split along ideological lines are so easily 17 as unjust. [A] concepts 概念 [B] theories 理论 [C] divisions 划分 [D] conventions 惯例 💡 考场思路like liberty and property是对空格的举例：自由、财产都是基本社会"概念"。

entries.title: When the court deals with social policy decisions, the law it 16 is inescapably
entries.text: When the court deals with social policy decisions, the law it 16 is inescapably political—which is why decisions split along ideological lines are so easily 17 as unjust. [A] excludes 排除 [B] questions 质疑 [C] shapes 形成/塑造 [D] controls 控制 答案 C shapes Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social 15 like liberty and property. When the court deals with social policy decisions, the law it 16 is inescapably political—which is why decisions split along ideological lines are so easily 17 as unjust. [A] excludes 排除 [B] questions 质疑 [C] shapes 形成/塑造 [D] controls 控制 💡 考场思路the law it shapes = 它（法院）所形成/塑造的法律。

entries.title: When the court deals with social policy decisions, the law it 16 is inescapably
entries.text: When the court deals with social policy decisions, the law it 16 is inescapably political—which is why decisions split along ideological lines are so easily 17 as unjust. [A] dismissed 被斥为 [B] released 释放 [C] ranked 排名 [D] distorted 扭曲 答案 A dismissed Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social 15 like liberty and property. When the court deals with social policy decisions, the law it 16 is inescapably political—which is why decisions split along ideological lines are so easily 17 as unjust. [A] dismissed 被斥为 [B] released 释放 [C] ranked 排名 [D] distorted 扭曲 💡 考场思路be dismissed as = 被斥为……。按意识形态划线的裁决容易被斥为不公正。

entries.title: The justices must 18 doubts about the court's legitimacy by making themselves 19
entries.text: The justices must 18 doubts about the court's legitimacy by making themselves 19 to the code of conduct. [A] suppress 压制 [B] exploit 利用 [C] address 解决/处理 [D] ignore 忽视 答案 C address The justices must 18 doubts about the court's legitimacy by making themselves 19 to the code of conduct. That would make rulings more likely to be seen as separate from politics and, 20, convincing as law. [A] suppress 压制 [B] exploit 利用 [C] address 解决/处理 [D] ignore 忽视 💡 考场思路address doubts = 解决质疑。

entries.title: The justices must 18 doubts about the court's legitimacy by making themselves 19
entries.text: The justices must 18 doubts about the court's legitimacy by making themselves 19 to the code of conduct. [A] accessible 可接近的 [B] amiable 和蔼的 [C] agreeable 同意的 [D] accountable 负责的/应负责任的 答案 D accountable The justices must 18 doubts about the court's legitimacy by making themselves 19 to the code of conduct. That would make rulings more likely to be seen as separate from politics and, 20, convincing as law. [A] accessible 可接近的 [B] amiable 和蔼的 [C] agreeable 同意的 [D] accountable 负责的/应负责任的 💡 考场思路make oneself accountable to = 使自己对……负责。大法官应遵守行为准则。

entries.title: That would make rulings more likely to be seen as separate from politics and, 20
entries.text: That would make rulings more likely to be seen as separate from politics and, 20, convincing as law. [A] by all means 务必 [B] at all costs 不惜一切 [C] in a word 总之 [D] as a result 结果 答案 D as a result The justices must 18 doubts about the court's legitimacy by making themselves 19 to the code of conduct. That would make rulings more likely to be seen as separate from politics and, 20, convincing as law. [A] by all means 务必 [B] at all costs 不惜一切 [C] in a word 总之 [D] as a result 结果 💡 考场思路裁决被视为独立于政治，"结果"作为法律令人信服。因果顺承。 ⚠️ 完形总结本文讲最高法院大法官伦理与司法独立。核心考点：固定搭配（be bound by/be subject to/apply to/envision...as/upset/be dismissed as/address doubts）。

entries.title: According to the first paragraph, peer pressure often emerges as ___.
entries.text: According to the first paragraph, peer pressure often emerges as ___. [A] a supplement to the social cure. 社会疗法的一种补充。 [B] a stimulus to group dynamics. 对群体动力的一种刺激。 [C] an obstacle to social progress. 社会进步的一个障碍。 [D] a cause of undesirable behaviors. 答案 D According to the first paragraph, peer pressure often emerges as ___.根据第一段，同伴压力通常表现为___。 [A] a supplement to the social cure.社会疗法的一种补充。 [B] a stimulus to group dynamics.对群体动力的一种刺激。 [C] an obstacle to social progress.社会进步的一个障碍。 [D] a cause of undesirable behaviors. 💡 考场思路首段：It usually leads to no good—drinking, drugs and casual sex——同伴压力通常导致酗酒、吸毒、随意性行为等不良行为。

entries.title: Rosenberg holds that public-health advocates should ___.
entries.text: Rosenberg holds that public-health advocates should ___. [A] recruit professional advertisers. 招募专业广告人员。 [B] learn from advertisers' experience. [C] stay away from commercial advertisers. 远离商业广告主。 [D] recognize the limitations of advertisements. 认识到广告的局限性。 答案 B Rosenberg holds that public-health advocates should ___.Rosenberg认为，公共卫生倡导者应该___。 [A] recruit professional advertisers.招募专业广告人员。 [B] learn from advertisers' experience. [C] stay away from commercial advertisers.远离商业广告主。 [D] recognize the limitations of advertisements.认识到广告的局限性。 💡 考场思路第三段末：public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers——公共卫生倡导者应向广告商学习。take a page from = 向……学习。

entries.title: In the author's view, Rosenberg's book fails to ___.
entries.text: In the author's view, Rosenberg's book fails to ___. [A] adequately probe social and biological factors. [B] effectively evade the flaws of the social cure. 有效规避社会疗法的缺陷。 [C] illustrate the functions of state funding. 说明国家资助的功能。 [D] produce a long-lasting social effect. 产生持久的社会影响。 答案 A In the author's view, Rosenberg's book fails to ___.在作者看来， Rosenberg的书没有___。 [A] adequately probe social and biological factors. [B] effectively evade the flaws of the social cure.有效规避社会疗法的缺陷。 [C] illustrate the functions of state funding.说明国家资助的功能。 [D] produce a long-lasting social effect.产生持久的社会影响。 💡 考场思路第四段：not enough exploration of the social and biological factors——对社会和生物因素探讨不够。exploration = probe。

entries.title: Paragraph 5 shows that our imitation of behaviors ___.
entries.text: Paragraph 5 shows that our imitation of behaviors ___. [A] is harmful to our networks of friends. 对我们的人际网络有害。 [B] will mislead behavioral studies. 将误导行为研究。 [C] occurs without our realizing it. [D] can produce negative health habits. 可能产生不良健康习惯。 答案 C Paragraph 5 shows that our imitation of behaviors ___.第5段表明，我们模仿的行为___。 [A] is harmful to our networks of friends.对我们的人际网络有害。 [B] will mislead behavioral studies.将误导行为研究。 [C] occurs without our realizing it. [D] can produce negative health habits.可能产生不良健康习惯。 💡 考场思路第五段末：we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day——我们无意识地模仿每天看到的行为。unconsciously = without realizing it。

entries.title: The author suggests in the last paragraph that the effect of peer pressure is __
entries.text: The author suggests in the last paragraph that the effect of peer pressure is ___. [A] harmful. 有害的。 [B] desirable. 可取的；理想的。 [C] profound. 深刻的。 [D] questionable. 答案 D The author suggests in the last paragraph that the effect of peer pressure is ___.作者在最后一段中指出，同伴压力的影响是___。 [A] harmful.有害的。 [B] desirable.可取的；理想的。 [C] profound.深刻的。 [D] questionable. 💡 考场思路末段：The tactic never really works...we insist on choosing our own friends——外部设计的社会疗法行不通，暗示同伴压力的效果值得怀疑。 核心词汇 contend v. 主张 peer pressure 同伴压力 dynamics n. 动力 perceptive adj. 敏锐的 spot-on adj. 一针见血的 mobilize v. 调动 glaring adj. 明显的 imitate v. 模仿

entries.title: The phrase "reneging on" (Para. 1) is closest in meaning to ___.
entries.text: The phrase "reneging on" (Para. 1) is closest in meaning to ___. [A] condemning. 谴责的。 [B] reaffirming. 重申；再次确认。 [C] dishonoring. [D] securing. 获取；确保。 答案 C The phrase "reneging on" (Para. 1) is closest in meaning to ___.短语“违背” （第1段）的含义最接近___。 [A] condemning.谴责的。 [B] reaffirming.重申；再次确认。 [C] dishonoring. [D] securing.获取；确保。 💡 考场思路后句说公司长期承诺遵守州规章，现在却宣布要在联邦法院质疑其合宪——即"背弃/违背"承诺。renege on = dishonor。

entries.title: By entering into the 2002 agreement, Entergy intended to ___.
entries.text: By entering into the 2002 agreement, Entergy intended to ___. [A] obtain protection from Vermont regulators. 获得佛蒙特州监管机构的保护。 [B] seek favor from the federal legislature. 寻求联邦立法机构的支持。 [C] acquire an extension of its business license. 获得其营业执照的延期。 [D] get permission to purchase a power plant. 答案 D By entering into the 2002 agreement, Entergy intended to ___.通过签订2002年协议， Entergy打算___。 [A] obtain protection from Vermont regulators.获得佛蒙特州监管机构的保护。 [B] seek favor from the federal legislature.寻求联邦立法机构的支持。 [C] acquire an extension of its business license.获得其营业执照的延期。 [D] get permission to purchase a power plant. 💡 考场思路第三段：As a condition of receiving state approval for the sale, the company agreed to...——作为获得州政府批准这项"出售"（即购买电厂）的条件，公司才同意2012年后需申请许可。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, Entergy seems to have problems with its ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, Entergy seems to have problems with its ___. [A] managerial practices. [B] technical innovativeness. 技术创新性。 [C] financial goals. 财务目标。 [D] business vision. 商业远见。 答案 A According to Paragraph 4, Entergy seems to have problems with its ___.根据第4段， Entergy的___似乎有问题。 [A] managerial practices. [B] technical innovativeness.技术创新性。 [C] financial goals.财务目标。 [D] business vision.商业远见。 💡 考场思路第四段：raised serious questions about both Vermont Yankee's safety and Entergy's management——事故和误导性声明使人们质疑其管理。management = managerial practices。

entries.title: In the author's view, the Vermont case will test ___.
entries.text: In the author's view, the Vermont case will test ___. [A] Entergy's capacity to fulfill all its promises. Entergy履行其所有承诺的能力。 [B] the nature of states' patchwork regulations. 各州拼凑式监管的本质。 [C] the federal authority over nuclear issues. 联邦在核问题上的权力。 [D] the limits of states' power over nuclear issues. 答案 D In the author's view, the Vermont case will test ___.在作者看来，佛蒙特州的案例将测试___。 [A] Entergy's capacity to fulfill all its promises.Entergy履行其所有承诺的能力。 [B] the nature of states' patchwork regulations.各州拼凑式监管的本质。 [C] the federal authority over nuclear issues.联邦在核问题上的权力。 [D] the limits of states' power over nuclear issues. 💡 考场思路第五段：Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend——检验州监管权究竟能延伸多远。how far = the limits。

entries.title: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ___. [A] Entergy's business elsewhere might be affected. [B] the authority of the NRC will be defied. NRC的权威将遭到挑战。 [C] Entergy will withdraw its Plymouth application. Entergy将撤回其普利茅斯申请。 [D] Vermont's reputation might be damaged. 佛蒙特州的声誉可能受损。 答案 A It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ___.从最后一段可以推断出___。 [A] Entergy's business elsewhere might be affected. [B] the authority of the NRC will be defied.NRC的权威将遭到挑战。 [C] Entergy will withdraw its Plymouth application.Entergy将撤回其普利茅斯申请。 [D] Vermont's reputation might be damaged.佛蒙特州的声誉可能受损。 💡 考场思路末段说Entergy还运营11座反应堆，正申请普利茅斯核电站再运营20年，NRC审查时会记住它的承诺值多少钱——暗示Entergy在别处的业务会受影响。 核心词汇 renegue on 背弃 outrage n. 愤怒 constitutionality n. 合宪性 surfing n. 令人震惊的 legislature n. 立法机构 obscure adj. 模糊的 precedent n. 先例 pledge v. 承诺

entries.title: According to the first paragraph, the process of discovery is characterized by i
entries.text: According to the first paragraph, the process of discovery is characterized by its ___. [A] uncertainty and complexity. [B] misconception and deceptiveness. 误解与欺骗性。 [C] logicality and objectivity. 逻辑性与客观性。 [D] systematicness and regularity. 系统性与规范性。 答案 A According to the first paragraph, the process of discovery is characterized by its ___.根据第一段，发现过程的特征在于其___。 [A] uncertainty and complexity. [B] misconception and deceptiveness.误解与欺骗性。 [C] logicality and objectivity.逻辑性与客观性。 [D] systematicness and regularity.系统性与规范性。 💡 考场思路首段：discovery frequently follows an ambiguous and complicated route——发现之路模糊而复杂。ambiguous = uncertainty，complicated = complexity。

entries.title: It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that the credibility process requires ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that the credibility process requires ___. [A] strict inspection. 严格检查。 [B] shared efforts. [C] individual wisdom. 个人智慧。 [D] persistent innovation. 持续创新。 答案 B It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that the credibility process requires ___.从第2款可以推断，可信度流程需要___。 [A] strict inspection.严格检查。 [B] shared efforts. [C] individual wisdom.个人智慧。 [D] persistent innovation.持续创新。 💡 考场思路第二段：it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim——需要集体审视和接受。collective = shared。

entries.title: Paragraph 3 shows that a discovery claim becomes credible after it ___.
entries.text: Paragraph 3 shows that a discovery claim becomes credible after it ___. [A] has attracted the attention of the general public. 已引起公众的注意。 [B] has been examined by the scientific community. [C] has received recognition from editors and reviewers. 已获得编辑与审稿人的认可。 [D] has been frequently quoted by peer scientists. 常被同行科学家引用。 答案 B Paragraph 3 shows that a discovery claim becomes credible after it ___.第3款表明，发现声明在___之后变得可信。 [A] has attracted the attention of the general public.已引起公众的注意。 [B] has been examined by the scientific community. [C] has received recognition from editors and reviewers.已获得编辑与审稿人的认可。 [D] has been frequently quoted by peer scientists.常被同行科学家引用。 💡 考场思路第三段末：the interaction and confrontation... transforms an individual's discovery claim into the community's credible discovery——经过学界互动对抗后才成为可信发现。

entries.title: Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that ___.
entries.text: Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that ___. [A] scientific claims will survive challenges. 科学论断将经得起挑战。 [B] discoveries today inspire future research. 今天的发现激励未来的研究。 [C] efforts to make discoveries are justified. 探索发现的努力是合理的。 [D] scientific work calls for a critical mind. 答案 D Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that ___.Albert Szent-Györgyi很可能会同意___。 [A] scientific claims will survive challenges.科学论断将经得起挑战。 [B] discoveries today inspire future research.今天的发现激励未来的研究。 [C] efforts to make discoveries are justified.探索发现的努力是合理的。 [D] scientific work calls for a critical mind. 💡 考场思路森特-哲尔吉："看到每个人都看到的，想到没人想到的"——即科学工作需要批判性思维，不盲从。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title of the text? [A] Novelty as an Engine of Scientific Development. 新奇作为科学发展的引擎。 [B] Collective Scrutiny in Scientific Discovery. 科学发现中的集体审查。 [C] Evolution of Credibility in Doing Science. [D] Challenge to Credibility at the Gate to Science. 科学之门处可信度面临的挑战。 答案 C Which of the following would be the best title of the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Novelty as an Engine of Scientific Development.新奇作为科学发展的引擎。 [B] Collective Scrutiny in Scientific Discovery.科学发现中的集体审查。 [C] Evolution of Credibility in Doing Science. [D] Challenge to Credibility at the Gate to Science.科学之门处可信度面临的挑战。 💡 考场思路全文核心：发现声明如何经过可信性过程演变为可信发现，即科学中可信性的发展演变。C既点出 credibility 又点出过程性。 核心词汇 ambiguous adj. 模糊的 proto-science n. 原科学 scrutiny n. 审视 credibility n. 可信性 paradox n. 悖论 refutation n. 反驳 prevailing adj. 盛行的 novelty n. 新奇

entries.title: It can be learned from the first paragraph that ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from the first paragraph that ___. [A] Teamsters still have a large body of members. 卡车司机工会仍拥有庞大的成员群体。 [B] Jimmy Hoffa used to work as a civil servant. Jimmy Hoffa曾是一名公务员。 [C] unions have enlarged their public-sector membership. [D] the government has improved its relationship with unionists. 政府已改善与工会人士的关系。 答案 C It can be learned from the first paragraph that ___.从第一段可以看出， ___。 [A] Teamsters still have a large body of members.卡车司机工会仍拥有庞大的成员群体。 [B] Jimmy Hoffa used to work as a civil servant.Jimmy Hoffa曾是一名公务员。 [C] unions have enlarged their public-sector membership. [D] the government has improved its relationship with unionists.政府已改善与工会人士的关系。 💡 考场思路首段：政府工作人员工会比例从1960年的1/10升至现在的36%，2009年公共部门工会人数超过私营部门——工会在公共部门的会员扩大了。

entries.title: Which of the following is true of Paragraph 2?
entries.text: Which of the following is true of Paragraph 2? [A] Public-sector unions are prudent in taking actions. 公共部门工会在行动上审慎。 [B] Education is required for public-sector union membership. 加入公共部门工会需要受教育。 [C] Labor Party has long been fighting against public-sector unions. 工党长期与公共部门工会对立。 [D] Public-sector unions seldom get in trouble for their actions. 答案 D Which of the following is true of Paragraph 2?对于第2款，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] Public-sector unions are prudent in taking actions.公共部门工会在行动上审慎。 [B] Education is required for public-sector union membership.加入公共部门工会需要受教育。 [C] Labor Party has long been fighting against public-sector unions.工党长期与公共部门工会对立。 [D] Public-sector unions seldom get in trouble for their actions. 💡 考场思路第二段：they can shut things down without suffering much in the way of consequences——他们可以停工而不必承担太多后果。= 很少因行动惹麻烦。

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraph 4 that the income in the state sector is ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraph 4 that the income in the state sector is ___. [A] illegally secured. 非法获得的。 [B] indirectly augmented. [C] excessively increased. 过度增加的。 [D] fairly adjusted. 得到公平调整。 答案 B It can be learned from Paragraph 4 that the income in the state sector is ___.从第4段中可以了解到，国有部门的收入为___。 [A] illegally secured.非法获得的。 [B] indirectly augmented. [C] excessively increased.过度增加的。 [D] fairly adjusted.得到公平调整。 💡 考场思路第四段：工资增长适度，但通过增加假期和养老金变相增加——即收入是间接增加的。indirectly augmented。

entries.title: The example of the unions in Wisconsin shows that unions ___.
entries.text: The example of the unions in Wisconsin shows that unions ___. [A] often run against the current political system. 常常与现行政治体制相悖。 [B] can change people's political attitudes. 能改变人们的政治态度。 [C] may be a barrier to public-sector reforms. [D] are dominant in the government. 在政府中占主导地位。 答案 C The example of the unions in Wisconsin shows that unions ___.威斯康星州工会的例子表明，工会___。 [A] often run against the current political system.常常与现行政治体制相悖。 [B] can change people's political attitudes.能改变人们的政治态度。 [C] may be a barrier to public-sector reforms. [D] are dominant in the government.在政府中占主导地位。 💡 考场思路威斯康星州工会召集数千人对抗州长推动改革——说明工会阻碍公共部门改革。

entries.title: John Donahue's attitude towards the public-sector system is one of ___.
entries.text: John Donahue's attitude towards the public-sector system is one of ___. [A] disapproval. [B] tolerance. 宽容；容忍。 [C] appreciation. 欣赏；感激。 [D] indifference. 冷漠。 答案 A John Donahue's attitude towards the public-sector system is one of ___.John Donahue对公共部门系统的态度是___之一。 [A] disapproval. entries.title: In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and
entries.text: In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and seeks a theory of everything—a single generative equation for all we see. In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and seeks a theory of everything—a single generative equation for all we see. 在物理学中，有一种方法将这种对统一性的渴求推向极致，寻求一种万有理论——一个能阐释我们所见一切的生成性公式。 采分点① impulse 冲动/渴求；② unification 统一；③ take...to its extreme 推向极致；④ a theory of everything 万有理论。

entries.title: Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common ori
entries.text: Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings. Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings. 这里，达尔文学说似乎提供了正当理由：如果全人类有共同的起源，那么似乎有理由认为，文化多样性也可以追溯到更为狭窄的开端。 采分点① justification 正当理由；② trace to 追溯到；③ constrained beginnings 受局限的开端。

entries.title: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand h
entries.text: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms. To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms. 把独特之物从共享之物中筛选出来，或许能让我们理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的，以及从进化或认知角度看是什么在引导它。 采分点① filter out 筛选；② arise 产生；③ in...terms 从……角度；④ cognitive 认知的。

entries.title: The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality
entries.text: The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints. The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints. 第二个由约书亚·格林伯格提出，它对普遍性采取了更为实证的研究方法，识别出许多语言共有的特征（尤其是词序方面），这些特征被认为代表了由认知局限所导致的偏向。 采分点① empirical 实证的；② universality 普遍性；③ trait 特征；④ cognitive constraints 认知局限。

You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The drawing shows two people facing a bottle that has fallen over and spilled some liquid. One frowns and cries, "It's all over!" while the other says optimistically, "Luckily there is still some left." Faced with the same situation, the two hold completely different attitudes. Part B 大作文（20分）— 乐观与悲观（面对同一只打翻的瓶子） 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The drawing shows two people facing a bottle that has fallen over and spilled some liquid. One frowns and cries, "It's all over!" while the other says optimistically, "Luckily there is still some left." Faced with the same situation, the two hold completely different attitudes. 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 图画描述 图中有两个人面对一只打翻在地、洒了一些液体的瓶子。一个人愁眉苦脸地喊道："全完了！"另一个人却乐观地说："幸好还剩点儿。"面对同一种境况，两人态度截然不同。 审题框架 三段式：①描述图画（打翻的瓶子+两种反应）；②阐释寓意（不同人面对困境有乐观和悲观两种态度，乐观更可取）；③评论（应保持积极心态）。160-200词。 参考范文 The cartoon vividly depicts two men reacting in opposite ways to the same spilled bottle. The drawing conveys a thought-provoking message: our attitude often matters more than the situation itself. entries.title: Priestly criticizes her assistant for her ___.
entries.text: Priestly criticizes her assistant for her ___. [A] lack of imagination. 缺乏想象力。 [B] poor bargaining skill. 拙劣的谈判技巧。 [C] obsession with high fashion. 对高端时尚的痴迷。 [D] insensitivity to fashion. 答案 D Priestly criticizes her assistant for her ___.Priestly因为她的___而批评她的助手。 [A] lack of imagination.缺乏想象力。 [B] poor bargaining skill.拙劣的谈判技巧。 [C] obsession with high fashion.对高端时尚的痴迷。 [D] insensitivity to fashion. 💡 考场思路首段：scolds her assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn't affect her——助手以为高级时装跟自己无关。insensitivity to fashion = 对时尚不敏感。

entries.title: According to Cline, mass-market labels urge consumers to ___.
entries.text: According to Cline, mass-market labels urge consumers to ___. [A] combat unnecessary waste. 遏制不必要的浪费。 [B] shop for their garments more frequently. [C] resist the influence of advertisements. 抵制广告的影响。 [D] shut out the feverish fashion world. 将狂热的时尚界拒之门外。 答案 B According to Cline, mass-market labels urge consumers to ___.根据Cline的说法，大众市场标签敦促消费者___。 [A] combat unnecessary waste.遏制不必要的浪费。 [B] shop for their garments more frequently. [C] resist the influence of advertisements.抵制广告的影响。 [D] shut out the feverish fashion world.将狂热的时尚界拒之门外。 💡 考场思路第二段：renew their wardrobe every few weeks——每隔几周就更新衣橱，即更频繁地买衣服。

entries.text: The word "indictment" (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___. [A] accusation. [B] enthusiasm. 热情；热忱。 [C] indifference. 冷漠；漠不关心。 [D] tolerance. 宽容。 答案 A The word "indictment" (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___.“起诉书”一词（第2段）的含义最接近___。 [A] accusation. [B] enthusiasm.热情；热忱。 [C] indifference.冷漠；漠不关心。 [D] tolerance.宽容。 💡 考场思路《Overdressed》这本书批判快时尚浪费、过度消耗资源，indictment = 控诉、谴责。

entries.title: Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph?
entries.text: Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph? [A] Vanity has more often been found in idealists. 虚荣更多见于理想主义者。 [B] The fast-fashion industry ignores sustainability. 快时尚行业忽视可持续性。 [C] Pricing is vital to environment-friendly purchasing. [D] People are more interested in affordable garments. 人们对平价服装更感兴趣。 答案 C Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph?从最后一段可以推断出以下哪项？ [A] Vanity has more often been found in idealists.虚荣更多见于理想主义者。 [B] The fast-fashion industry ignores sustainability.快时尚行业忽视可持续性。 [C] Pricing is vital to environment-friendly purchasing. [D] People are more interested in affordable garments.人们对平价服装更感兴趣。 💡 考场思路末句：people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to——人们只有在买不起（不买不行）时才会可持续购物。= 价格对环保消费至关重要。

entries.title: What is the subject of the text?
entries.text: What is the subject of the text? [A] Satire on an extravagant lifestyle. 对奢侈生活方式的讽刺。 [B] Challenge to a high-fashion myth. 对高级时装神话的挑战。 [C] Criticism of the fast-fashion industry. [D] Exposure of a mass-market secret. 大众市场秘密的曝光。 答案 C What is the subject of the text?本文的主题是什么？ [A] Satire on an extravagant lifestyle.对奢侈生活方式的讽刺。 [B] Challenge to a high-fashion myth.对高级时装神话的挑战。 [C] Criticism of the fast-fashion industry. [D] Exposure of a mass-market secret.大众市场秘密的曝光。 💡 考场思路全文围绕《Overdressed》对快时尚行业的批判展开：浪费、剥削劳工、破坏环境。 核心词汇 scold v. 斥责 indictment n. 控诉 disposable adj. 一次性的 hijack v. 劫持 inventory n. 库存 curb v. 控制 vanity n. 虚荣心 sustainable adj. 可持续的

entries.title: It is suggested in Paragraph 1 that "behavioural" ads help advertisers to ___.
entries.text: It is suggested in Paragraph 1 that "behavioural" ads help advertisers to ___. [A] lower their operational costs. 降低其运营成本。 [B] ease competition among themselves. 缓和彼此间的竞争。 [C] avoid complaints from consumers. 避免消费者的投诉。 [D] provide better online services. 答案 D It is suggested in Paragraph 1 that "behavioural" ads help advertisers to ___.第1款建议“行为”广告帮助广告商___。 [A] lower their operational costs.降低其运营成本。 [B] ease competition among themselves.缓和彼此间的竞争。 [C] avoid complaints from consumers.避免消费者的投诉。 [D] provide better online services. 💡 考场思路首段说一半广告预算浪费，行为广告通过精准投放把浪费减少——即广告更有效。结合后文"less targeted ads"是坏事，反推行为广告让广告更精准有效。

entries.title: "The industry" (Para. 3) refers to ___.
entries.text: "The industry" (Para. 3) refers to ___. [A] online advertisers. 在线广告商。 [B] e-commerce conductors. 电子商务的经营者。 [C] digital information analysts. 数字信息分析师。 [D] internet browser developers. 答案 D "The industry" (Para. 3) refers to ___.“行业” （第3段）是指___。 [A] online advertisers.在线广告商。 [B] e-commerce conductors.电子商务的经营者。 [C] digital information analysts.数字信息分析师。 [D] internet browser developers. 💡 考场思路第三段提到FTC提议在浏览器中加DNT，微软IE、苹果Safari、谷歌Chrome都跟进——the industry 指浏览器开发商。

entries.title: Bob Liodice holds that setting DNT as a default ___.
entries.text: Bob Liodice holds that setting DNT as a default ___. [A] goes against human nature. 违背人性。 [B] fails to affect the ad industry. 未能影响广告业。 [C] will not benefit consumers. [D] may cut the number of junk ads. 可能减少垃圾广告的数量。 答案 C Bob Liodice holds that setting DNT as a default ___.Bob Liodice认为将DNT设置为默认值___。 [A] goes against human nature.违背人性。 [B] fails to affect the ad industry.未能影响广告业。 [C] will not benefit consumers. [D] may cut the number of junk ads.可能减少垃圾广告的数量。 💡 考场思路第五段：consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information——消费者处境会更糟。= 不会让消费者受益。

entries.title: Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 6?
entries.text: Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 6? [A] Advertisers are willing to implement DNT. 广告商愿意实施“禁止追踪”（DNT）。 [B] DNT may not serve its intended purpose. [C] DNT is losing its popularity among consumers. DNT在消费者中正失去人气。 [D] Advertisers are obliged to offer behavioural ads. 广告主有义务提供行为广告。 答案 B Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 6?根据第6段，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] Advertisers are willing to implement DNT.广告商愿意实施“禁止追踪”（DNT）。 [B] DNT may not serve its intended purpose. [C] DNT is losing its popularity among consumers.DNT在消费者中正失去人气。 [D] Advertisers are obliged to offer behavioural ads.广告主有义务提供行为广告。 💡 考场思路第六段：收到DNT信号不强制停止追踪，有些公司可能无视DNT照常追踪——即DNT达不到预期目的。

entries.title: The author's attitude towards what Brendon Lynch said in his blog is one of ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude towards what Brendon Lynch said in his blog is one of ___. [A] appreciation. 欣赏；感激。 [B] understanding. 理解；谅解。 [C] indulgence. 纵容；沉溺。 [D] skepticism. 怀疑；质疑态度。 答案 D The author's attitude towards what Brendon Lynch said in his blog is one of ___.作者对Brendon Lynch在他的博客中所说的话的态度是___之一。 [A] appreciation.欣赏；感激。 [B] understanding.理解；谅解。 [C] indulgence.纵容；沉溺。 [D] skepticism.怀疑；质疑态度。 💡 考场思路末句反问：Could it really be that simple?（事情真有这么简单吗？）——质疑林奇的说辞。 核心词汇 budget n. 预算 behavioural adj. 行为的 default n. 默认设置 oblige v. 强制 opt v. 选择 compliance n. 遵守 norm n. 规范 privacy n. 隐私

entries.title: Our vision of the future used to be inspired by ___.
entries.text: Our vision of the future used to be inspired by ___. [A] our desire for lives of fulfillment. 我们对充实生活的渴望。 [B] our faith in science and technology. [C] our awareness of potential risks. 我们对潜在风险的意识。 [D] our belief in equal opportunity. 我们对机会均等的信念。 答案 B Our vision of the future used to be inspired by ___.我们过去对未来的愿景曾受到___的启发。 [A] our desire for lives of fulfillment.我们对充实生活的渴望。 [B] our faith in science and technology. [C] our awareness of potential risks.我们对潜在风险的意识。 [D] our belief in equal opportunity.我们对机会均等的信念。 💡 考场思路首段：Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity——过去我们乐观是因为相信科技能解决一切。

entries.title: The IUCN's "Red List" suggests that human beings are ___.
entries.text: The IUCN's "Red List" suggests that human beings are ___. [A] a misplaced race. 一场错位之争。 [B] a sustained species. [C] the world's dominant power. 世界主导力量。 [D] a threat to the environment. 对环境的威胁。 答案 B The IUCN's "Red List" suggests that human beings are ___.世界自然保护联盟的“红色名录”表明，人类是___。 [A] a misplaced race.一场错位之争。 [B] a sustained species. [C] the world's dominant power.世界主导力量。 [D] a threat to the environment.对环境的威胁。 💡 考场思路红色名录把智人列为"无危"，分布广、适应强、数量仍在增长——说明人类是一个可持续存续的物种。

entries.title: Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 5?
entries.text: Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 5? [A] The interest in science fiction is on the rise. 对科幻小说的兴趣正在上升。 [B] Arc helps limit the scope of futurological studies. Arc有助于限制未来学研究的范畴。 [C] Technology offers solutions to social problems. 技术为社会问题提供解决方案。 [D] Our immediate future is hard to conceive. 答案 D Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 5?根据第5段，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] The interest in science fiction is on the rise.对科幻小说的兴趣正在上升。 [B] Arc helps limit the scope of futurological studies.Arc有助于限制未来学研究的范畴。 [C] Technology offers solutions to social problems.技术为社会问题提供解决方案。 [D] Our immediate future is hard to conceive. 💡 考场思路第五段：当今技术演进及其社会后果复杂得令人眼花缭乱，最好留给科幻作家和未来学家——即近期未来很难设想。

entries.title: To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to ___.
entries.text: To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to ___. [A] draw on our experience from the past. [B] adopt an optimistic view of the world. 对世界持乐观看法。 [C] explore our planet's abundant resources. 开发我们星球丰富的资源。 [D] curb our ambition to reshape history. 遏制我们重塑历史的野心。 答案 A To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to ___.为了确保人类的未来，这对___至关重要。 [A] draw on our experience from the past. [B] adopt an optimistic view of the world.对世界持乐观看法。 [C] explore our planet's abundant resources.开发我们星球丰富的资源。 [D] curb our ambition to reshape history.遏制我们重塑历史的野心。 💡 考场思路第六段：the past holds the key to the future——过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙，要从过去的长期模式中吸取经验。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title of the text? [A] Uncertainty about Our Future 关于我们未来的不确定性 [B] Evolution of the Human Species 人类物种的演化 [C] The Ever-bright Prospects of Mankind [D] Science, Technology and Humanity 科学、技术与人文 答案 C Which of the following would be the best title of the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Uncertainty about Our Future关于我们未来的不确定性 [B] Evolution of the Human Species人类物种的演化 [C] The Ever-bright Prospects of Mankind [D] Science, Technology and Humanity科学、技术与人文 💡 考场思路全文反驳"人类未来悲观论"，论证从长时段看人类前景光明。C既点出mankind又点出乐观。 核心词汇 utopia n. 乌托邦 gloominess n. 悲观 endure v. 存续 adaptable adj. 适应性强的 futurologist n. 未来学家 envisage v. 设想 descendant n. 后代 passing fad 一时时髦

entries.title: Three provisions of Arizona's plan were overturned because they ___.
entries.text: Three provisions of Arizona's plan were overturned because they ___. [A] overstepped the authority of federal immigration law. 逾越了联邦移民法的权限。 [B] disturbed the power balance between different states. 扰乱了不同州之间的权力平衡。 [C] deprived the federal police of Constitutional powers. 剥夺了联邦警察的宪法权力。 [D] contradicted both the federal and state policies. 答案 D Three provisions of Arizona's plan were overturned because they ___.亚利桑那州计划的三项规定被推翻，因为它们___。 [A] overstepped the authority of federal immigration law.逾越了联邦移民法的权限。 [B] disturbed the power balance between different states.扰乱了不同州之间的权力平衡。 [C] deprived the federal police of Constitutional powers.剥夺了联邦警察的宪法权力。 [D] contradicted both the federal and state policies. 💡 考场思路亚利桑那州试图制定与联邦政策并行的州政策，侵犯联邦特权——即与联邦法律相抵触。

entries.title: On which of the following did the Justices agree, according to Paragraph 4?
entries.text: On which of the following did the Justices agree, according to Paragraph 4? [A] States' independence from federal immigration law. 各州对联邦移民法的独立性。 [B] Federal officers' duty to withhold immigrants' information. 联邦官员隐瞒移民信息的职责。 [C] States' legitimate role in immigration enforcement. [D] Congress's intervention in immigration enforcement. 国会对移民执法的干预。 答案 C On which of the following did the Justices agree, according to Paragraph 4?根据第4款，法官同意以下哪些内容？ [A] States' independence from federal immigration law.各州对联邦移民法的独立性。 [B] Federal officers' duty to withhold immigrants' information.联邦官员隐瞒移民信息的职责。 [C] States' legitimate role in immigration enforcement. [D] Congress's intervention in immigration enforcement.国会对移民执法的干预。 💡 考场思路第四段：大法官允许亚利桑那州警方核查接触执法者的合法身份，因为国会一直设想联邦与州联合执法——即承认州在移民执法中的合法角色。

entries.title: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that the Alien and Sedition Acts ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that the Alien and Sedition Acts ___. [A] violated the Constitution. 违反了宪法。 [B] stood in favor of the states. [C] supported the federal statute. 支持该联邦法规。 [D] undermined the states' interests. 损害了各州的利益。 答案 B It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that the Alien and Sedition Acts ___.从第5款可以推断，《外国人和煽动法》___。 [A] violated the Constitution.违反了宪法。 [B] stood in favor of the states. [C] supported the federal statute.支持该联邦法规。 [D] undermined the states' interests.损害了各州的利益。 💡 考场思路斯卡利亚为可追溯到《客籍法和惩治煽动叛乱法》的州权辩护——说明该法案支持州权。

entries.title: The White House claims that its power of enforcement ___.
entries.text: The White House claims that its power of enforcement ___. [A] outweighs that held by the states. [B] is established by federal statutes. 由联邦法规确立。 [C] is dependent on the states' support. 依赖于各州的支持。 [D] rarely goes against state laws. 很少违背州法律。 答案 A The White House claims that its power of enforcement ___.白宫声称其执法权力___。 [A] outweighs that held by the states. [B] is established by federal statutes.由联邦法规确立。 [C] is dependent on the states' support.依赖于各州的支持。 [D] rarely goes against state laws.很少违背州法律。 💡 考场思路第六段：白宫声称它可以废除任何它不认同的州法律——即白宫执法权凌驾于州之上。

entries.title: What can be learned from the last paragraph?
entries.text: What can be learned from the last paragraph? [A] Immigration issues are usually decided by Congress. 移民问题通常由国会决定。 [B] The Administration is dominant over immigration issues. 行政当局在移民问题上占主导。 [C] Justices wanted to strengthen its coordination with Congress. 大法官希望加强与国会的协调。 [D] Justices intended to check the power of the Administration. 答案 D What can be learned from the last paragraph?从最后一段可以学到什么？ [A] Immigration issues are usually decided by Congress.移民问题通常由国会决定。 [B] The Administration is dominant over immigration issues.行政当局在移民问题上占主导。 [C] Justices wanted to strengthen its coordination with Congress.大法官希望加强与国会的协调。 [D] Justices intended to check the power of the Administration. 💡 考场思路末句：Every Justice rightly rejected this remarkable claim——所有大法官都驳回了白宫的主张，即大法官们意图制约政府权力。 核心词汇 overturn v. 推翻 precede v. 优先于 intrude v. 侵犯 verify v. 核查 contemplate v. 设想 robust adj. 强有力的 invalidate v. 使无效 exclusively adv. 排他地

entries.title: yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it
entries.text: yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression. yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression. 然而，只要看看无家可归者创造的花园的照片，你就会意识到：尽管样式各异，这些花园除了表达装饰和创造性表达之外，还传达着人类其他各种根本的渴望。 采分点① it strikes one that 人们突然意识到；② for all 尽管；③ diversity of styles 样式多样；④ speak of 传达。

entries.title: A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as
entries.text: A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need. A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need. 无论多么简陋，一片宁静的圣地是人类独有的需求，而庇护所则是动物独有的需求。 采分点① sacred place 圣地；② crude 简陋的；③ distinctly 独特地；④ as opposed to 与……相对。

entries.title: The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce for
entries.text: The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce form into an urban environment where it either didn't exist or was not discernible as such. The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce form into an urban environment where it either didn't exist or was not discernible as such. 无家可归者的花园实际上就是无家之园，它们给城市环境引入了一种形式，这种形式要么原本不存在，要么无法被这样辨认出来。 采分点① in effect 实际上；② discernible 可辨认的；③ as such 照此本身。

entries.title: most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some
entries.text: most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic. most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic. 我们大多数人会陷入精神萎靡，通常将其归咎于某种心理状态，直到有一天我们置身花园，才会感觉烦闷感像变魔术一样消失了。 采分点① give in to 陷入/屈服于；② demoralization of spirit 精神萎靡；③ blame on 归咎于；④ as if by magic 像变魔术一样。

entries.title: It is this implicit or explicit reference to nature that fully justifies the use
entries.text: It is this implicit or explicit reference to nature that fully justifies the use of the word garden, though in a "liberated" sense, to describe these synthetic constructions. It is this implicit or explicit reference to nature that fully justifies the use of the word garden, though in a "liberated" sense, to describe these synthetic constructions. 正是这种对自然的或含蓄或明确的参照，充分证明了用"花园"一词（尽管是在"广义"上）来描述这些人造建筑是完全合理的。 采分点① 强调句 It is...that...；② implicit/explicit 含蓄/明确；③ justify 证明合理；④ synthetic constructions 人造建筑。

entries.text: Write an email to a foreign teacher in your department, inviting him/her to be a judge for the upcoming English speech contest. You should include any details that you think necessary. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 邀请外教担任评委 原题指令 Directions Write an email to a foreign teacher in your department, inviting him/her to be a judge for the upcoming English speech contest. You should include any details that you think necessary. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. 【译文】给你所在院系的一位外教写一封电子邮件，邀请他/她担任即将举行的英语演讲比赛的评委。可包含你认为必要的细节。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。 题目 给你们学院的一位外教写一封约100词的电子邮件，邀请他/她担任即将到来的英语演讲比赛的评委。包含你认为必要的细节。落款Li Ming。 审题 ① 格式：邮件；② 内容：邀请+比赛时间地点+评委职责+期待回复；③ 语气：礼貌诚恳。 参考范文 Dear Professor Smith, I am Li Ming, a student from the English Department. On behalf of the Students' Union, I am writing to sincerely invite you to serve as a judge for our upcoming English speech contest. The contest will be held in the Lecture Hall on the second floor of the Student Activity Center on the morning of June 15. Ten finalists will deliver speeches on the topic "My Dream, My China." entries.text: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows a group of graduates standing at a crossroads, each wearing a sign reading "Graduate". Before them lie four different roads marked "Job hunting", "Postgraduate exam", "Studying abroad" and "Starting a business". The title is "Choice". Part B 大作文（20分）— 毕业生的选择 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows a group of graduates standing at a crossroads, each wearing a sign reading "Graduate". Before them lie four different roads marked "Job hunting", "Postgraduate exam", "Studying abroad" and "Starting a business". The title is "Choice". 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 图中一群刚毕业的学生站在岔路口，每人头上都顶着写有 图画描述 图中一群刚毕业的学生站在一个岔路口，每人头上都顶着写有"毕业生"的牌子。前方有四条不同的路，分别写着"求职""考研""出国""创业"。标题：选择。 审题框架 三段式：①描述图画（毕业生站在人生岔路口面临多种选择）；②阐释寓意（人生关键期的选择至关重要，要结合自身实际理性规划）；③评论（没有最好的选择，只有最适合自己的）。160-200词。 参考范文 The cartoon vividly depicts a group of fresh graduates standing at a crossroads, each wearing a sign that reads "graduate." Before them lie four divergent paths labeled "job hunting," "pursuing postgraduate studies," "going abroad," and "starting a business." The caption reads simply: choice. The drawing captures a defining moment in every young person's life: upon graduation, we are suddenly confronted with a dizzying array of paths.
