entries.title: George Osborne's scheme was intended to ___.
entries.text: George Osborne's scheme was intended to ___. [A] motivate the unemployed to report voluntarily. 激励失业者主动报告。 [B] provide the unemployed with easier access to benefits. 让失业者更便捷地获取救济金。 [C] encourage jobseekers' active engagement in job seeking. [D] guarantee jobseekers' legitimate right to benefits. 保障求职者领取福利的合法权利。 答案 C George Osborne's scheme was intended to ___.乔治·奥斯本（ George Osborne ）的计划旨在___。 [A] motivate the unemployed to report voluntarily.激励失业者主动报告。 [B] provide the unemployed with easier access to benefits.让失业者更便捷地获取救济金。 [C] encourage jobseekers' active engagement in job seeking. [D] guarantee jobseekers' legitimate right to benefits.保障求职者领取福利的合法权利。 💡 考场思路首段：要求失业者带简历、注册在线求职、开始找工作才有资格领救济。目的就是"鼓励积极找工作"。 逐项分析 [A] 自愿报到 → 原文要求 weekly 强制报到，错； [B] 更容易拿救济 → 原文是加了条件、等7天，是更难拿； [C] 鼓励积极求职 → 正确，对应 start looking for work； [D] 保障救济权利 → 与原文"no entitlement"相反。 核心词汇 Chancellor of the Exchequer 财政大臣 eligible adj. 有资格的 dependency n. 依赖 subsidise v. 补贴 indulgent adj. 纵容的 claimant n. 申请人

entries.title: The phrase "to sign on" (Para. 2) most probably means ___.
entries.text: The phrase "to sign on" (Para. 2) most probably means ___. [A] to register for an allowance from the government. [B] to accept the government's restrictions on the allowance. 接受政府对津贴的限制。 [C] to check on the availability of jobs at the jobcentre. 查看就业中心职位的空缺情况。 [D] to attend a governmental job-training program. 参加政府就业培训项目。 答案 A The phrase "to sign on" (Para. 2) most probably means ___.短语“登录” （第2段）很可能意味着___。 [A] to register for an allowance from the government. [B] to accept the government's restrictions on the allowance.接受政府对津贴的限制。 [C] to check on the availability of jobs at the jobcentre.查看就业中心职位的空缺情况。 [D] to attend a governmental job-training program.参加政府就业培训项目。 💡 考场思路sign on 与 looking for work 对比："头几天应该用来找工作，而不是 sign on"——sign on 就是去登记领救济金。 逐项分析 [A] 登记领政府津贴 → 正确； [B] 接受政府限制 → 这不是 sign on 的含义； [C] 查询工作 → 与 looking for work 同义，不是对比项； [D] 参加培训 → 无中生有。

entries.title: What promoted the chancellor to develop his scheme?
entries.text: What promoted the chancellor to develop his scheme? [A] A desire to secure a better life for all. 一种为所有人争取更美好生活的愿望。 [B] An eagerness to protect the unemployed. 保护失业者的热忱。 [C] An urge to be generous to the claimants. 对申请者慷慨相助的冲动。 [D] A passion to ensure fairness for taxpayers. 答案 D What promoted the chancellor to develop his scheme?是什么促使财政大臣制定了他的计划？ [A] A desire to secure a better life for all.一种为所有人争取更美好生活的愿望。 [B] An eagerness to protect the unemployed.保护失业者的热忱。 [C] An urge to be generous to the claimants.对申请者慷慨相助的冲动。 [D] A passion to ensure fairness for taxpayers. 💡 考场思路第二段末："his zeal for 'fundamental fairness'—protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending"——动机是对纳税人公平的热忱。 逐项分析 [A] 为所有人更好生活 → 这是 Osborne 自我标榜，不是真正动机； [B] 保护失业者 → 与原文"最不慷慨的救济"相反； [C] 对申请人慷慨 → 与原文相反； [D] 对纳税人公平的热情 → 正确，对应 fundamental fairness / protecting taxpayer。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 3, being unemployed makes one feel ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 3, being unemployed makes one feel ___. [A] insulted. 受辱的；被冒犯的。 [B] uneasy. [C] enraged. 被激怒的。 [D] guilty. 有罪的；内疚的。 答案 B According to Paragraph 3, being unemployed makes one feel ___.根据第3段，失业会让人感到___。 [A] insulted.受辱的；被冒犯的。 [B] uneasy. [C] enraged.被激怒的。 [D] guilty.有罪的；内疚的。 💡 考场思路第三段：financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing, not wanted, excluded——这些都是"不安/难堪"的情绪。uneasy 概括最准。 逐项分析 [A] 受侮辱 → 程度过重，原文是 embarrassing 不是 insulted； [B] 不安/不适 → 正确，概括 terrifying/embarrassing/excluded； [C] 暴怒 → 无中生有； [D] 内疚 → 与原文相反，失业者无错。

entries.title: To which of the following would the author most probably agree?
entries.text: To which of the following would the author most probably agree? [A] Unemployment benefits should not be made conditional. [B] The British welfare system indulges jobseekers' laziness. 英国福利制度纵容求职者的懒惰。 [C] The jobseekers' allowance has met their actual needs. 求职津贴满足了他们的实际需求。 [D] Osborne's reforms will reduce the risk of unemployment. 奥斯本的改革将降低失业风险。 答案 A To which of the following would the author most probably agree?作者最有可能同意以下哪项？ [A] Unemployment benefits should not be made conditional. [B] The British welfare system indulges jobseekers' laziness.英国福利制度纵容求职者的懒惰。 [C] The jobseekers' allowance has met their actual needs.求职津贴满足了他们的实际需求。 [D] Osborne's reforms will reduce the risk of unemployment.奥斯本的改革将降低失业风险。 💡 考场思路末段：英国福利原则已不再是"无条件领取救济"，作者用 "It is as though 20 years of reforms never happened" 讽刺 Osborne，暗示他反对把救济变成有条件的。 逐项分析 [A] 救济不应有附加条件 → 正确，作者批评 conditional on actively seeking a job； [B] 英国福利纵容懒惰 → 这是 Osborne 的观点，作者用反讽语气否定； [C] 津贴满足需求 → 与原文 least generous 相反； [D] 改革降低失业风险 → 无中生有。 核心词汇 entitlement n. 应得权利 instinct n. 本能 unconditional adj. 无条件的 fortnightly adv. 每两周地

entries.title: A lot of students take up law as their profession due to ___.
entries.text: A lot of students take up law as their profession due to ___. [A] the growing demand from clients. 客户日益增长的需求。 [B] the increasing pressure of inflation. 日益增长的通胀压力。 [C] the prospect of working in big firms. 在大型企业工作的前景。 [D] the attraction of financial rewards. 答案 D A lot of students take up law as their profession due to ___.由于___ ，许多学生以法律为职业。 [A] the growing demand from clients.客户日益增长的需求。 [B] the increasing pressure of inflation.日益增长的通胀压力。 [C] the prospect of working in big firms.在大型企业工作的前景。 [D] the attraction of financial rewards. 💡 考场思路第二段："The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools"——最优秀律师赚大钱，吸引学生涌入法学院。 逐项分析 [A] 客户需求增长 → 未提及； [B] 通胀压力 → 原文 spending grew twice as fast as inflation 是支出增速，不是学生选法律的原因； [C] 进大所的前景 → 原文说 most graduates never get big-firm job； [D] 经济回报的吸引力 → 正确，对应 skyscrapers-full of money。 核心词汇 hostility n. 敌意 tort n. 侵权 excessive adj. 过度的 guild-like adj. 行会式的 liberalize v. 放开/自由化 conservative adj. 保守的

entries.title: Which of the following adds to the costs of legal education in most American sta
entries.text: Which of the following adds to the costs of legal education in most American states? [A] Higher tuition fees for undergraduate studies. 本科阶段更高的学费。 [B] Pursuing a bachelor's degree in another major. [C] Admissions approval from the bar association. 律师协会的准入批准。 [D] Receiving training by professional associations. 接受专业协会的培训。 答案 B Which of the following adds to the costs of legal education in most American states?以下哪项增加了大多数美国州的法律教育费用？ [A] Higher tuition fees for undergraduate studies.本科阶段更高的学费。 [B] Pursuing a bachelor's degree in another major. [C] Admissions approval from the bar association.律师协会的准入批准。 [D] Receiving training by professional associations.接受专业协会的培训。 💡 考场思路第三段：先读四年 unrelated subject 本科，再读三年法律——本科读不相关专业增加了时间和费用。 逐项分析 [A] 本科学费高 → 原文未提本科费高，而是多花了四年时间读无关专业； [B] 读另一个专业的本科 → 正确，a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject； [C] 律协批准入学 → 原文是 law schools 被授权，不是学生被批准； [D] 专业协会培训 → 无中生有。

entries.title: Hindrance to the reform of the legal system originates from ___.
entries.text: Hindrance to the reform of the legal system originates from ___. [A] non-professionals' sharp criticism. 非专业人士的尖锐批评。 [B] lawyers' and clients' strong resistance. 律师与客户的强烈抵制。 [C] the rigid bodies governing the profession. [D] the stern exam for would-be lawyers. 准律师面临的严格考试。 答案 C Hindrance to the reform of the legal system originates from ___.法律制度改革的障碍源于___。 [A] non-professionals' sharp criticism.非专业人士的尖锐批评。 [B] lawyers' and clients' strong resistance.律师与客户的强烈抵制。 [C] the rigid bodies governing the profession. [D] the stern exam for would-be lawyers.准律师面临的严格考试。 💡 考场思路第四段："the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them"——管理机构过于保守，即 rigid bodies。

entries.title: The guild-like ownership structure is considered "restrictive" partly because it
entries.text: The guild-like ownership structure is considered "restrictive" partly because it ___. [A] prevents lawyers from gaining due profits. 阻碍律师获得应得收益。 [B] keeps lawyers from holding law-firm shares. 阻止律师持有律所股份。 [C] aggravates the ethical situation in the trade. 加剧了行业内的伦理状况。 [D] bans outsiders' involvement in the profession. 答案 D The guild-like ownership structure is considered "restrictive" partly because it ___.公会式的所有权结构被认为是“限制性的” ，部分原因是它___。 [A] prevents lawyers from gaining due profits.阻碍律师获得应得收益。 [B] keeps lawyers from holding law-firm shares.阻止律师持有律所股份。 [C] aggravates the ethical situation in the trade.加剧了行业内的伦理状况。 [D] bans outsiders' involvement in the profession. 💡 考场思路第五段："non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm"——非律师不能持股，即禁止外部人士介入。 逐项分析 [A] 阻止律师获利 → 原文是费用高，律师能赚钱； [B] 阻止律师持股 → 原文是 non-lawyers 不能持股，律师可以； [C] 恶化职业道德 → 反对者称这反而保护道德，不是原因； [D] 禁止外部人士介入 → 正确。

entries.title: In this text, the author mainly discusses ___.
entries.text: In this text, the author mainly discusses ___. [A] flawed ownership of America's law firms and its causes. 美国律所所有权的缺陷及其成因。 [B] the factors that help make a successful lawyer in America. 在美国造就成功律师的因素。 [C] a problem in America's legal profession and solutions to it. [D] the role of undergraduate studies in America's legal education. 本科学习在美国法律教育中的作用。 答案 C In this text, the author mainly discusses ___.在本文中，作者主要讨论了___。 [A] flawed ownership of America's law firms and its causes.美国律所所有权的缺陷及其成因。 [B] the factors that help make a successful lawyer in America.在美国造就成功律师的因素。 [C] a problem in America's legal profession and solutions to it. [D] the role of undergraduate studies in America's legal education.本科学习在美国法律教育中的作用。 💡 考场思路全文结构：提出问题（美国法律行业费用高、学生涌入、侵权噩梦）→ 分析两大原因（教育成本、所有权结构）→ 给出改革建议。对应 [C]。 逐项分析 [A] 只讲所有权问题和原因 → 片面，只覆盖第五段； [B] 如何成为成功律师 → 偏离； [C] 法律行业的问题与解决方案 → 正确； [D] 本科作用 → 片面。 核心词汇 implement v. 实施 efficiency n. 效率 innovation n. 创新 restrictive adj. 限制性的

entries.title: The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as ___.
entries.text: The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as ___. [A] a symbol of the entrepreneurs' wealth. 企业家财富的象征。 [B] a possible replacement of the Nobel Prizes. 诺贝尔奖可能的一种替代。 [C] a handsome reward for researchers. [D] an example of bankers' investments. 银行家投资的一个例子。 答案 C The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as ___.基础物理学奖被视为___。 [A] a symbol of the entrepreneurs' wealth.企业家财富的象征。 [B] a possible replacement of the Nobel Prizes.诺贝尔奖可能的一种替代。 [C] a handsome reward for researchers. [D] an example of bankers' investments.银行家投资的一个例子。 💡 考场思路首段：a string of lucrative awards for researchers，300万美元——丰厚的研究者奖励。 逐项分析 [A] 企业家财富象征 → 资助方是互联网企业家，但奖项被看作"给研究者的奖"； [B] 可能替代诺贝尔奖 → 原文 joined the Nobel Prizes，不是 replacement； [C] 给研究者的丰厚奖励 → 正确； [D] 银行家投资 → 原文是 Internet entrepreneurs，不是 bankers。 核心词汇 lucrative adj. 赚钱的/丰厚的 upstart n. 暴发户 prestige n. 声望 perpetuate v. 使永存 legitimate adj. 合理的/合法的 recipients n. 获奖者

entries.title: The critics think that the new awards will most benefit ___.
entries.text: The critics think that the new awards will most benefit ___. [A] the profit-oriented scientists. 以利润为导向的科学家。 [B] the founders of the awards. [C] the achievement-based system. 以成就为基础的制度。 [D] peer-review-led research. 以同行评审为主导的研究。 答案 B The critics think that the new awards will most benefit ___.评论家们认为，新的奖项将使___受益最多。 [A] the profit-oriented scientists.以利润为导向的科学家。 [B] the founders of the awards. [C] the achievement-based system.以成就为基础的制度。 [D] peer-review-led research.以同行评审为主导的研究。 💡 考场思路第二段："The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them"——新奖项是幕后推手的自我推销，即让颁奖者（founders）受益。

entries.title: The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves ___.
entries.text: The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves ___. [A] the joint effort of modern researchers. [B] controversies over the recipients' status. 关于受奖者身份的争议。 [C] the demonstration of research findings. 研究成果的展示。 [D] legitimate concerns over the new prizes. 对新奖项的正当关切。 答案 A The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves ___.希格斯玻色子的发现是一个涉及___的典型案例。 [A] the joint effort of modern researchers. [B] controversies over the recipients' status.关于受奖者身份的争议。 [C] the demonstration of research findings.研究成果的展示。 [D] legitimate concerns over the new prizes.对新奖项的正当关切。 💡 考场思路例证题看论点。论点句："the collaborative nature of modern research"——现代研究的协作性质。希格斯玻色子例子就是为了说明这一点。 逐项分析 [A] 现代研究者的共同努力 → 正确，对应 collaborative nature； [B] 获奖者地位争议 → 这是例子的表面； [C] 研究发现展示 → 偏离； [D] 对新奖的合理担忧 → 这是本段主题，不是例子本身要说明的。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels?
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels? [A] History has never cast doubt on them. 历史从未对他们有过质疑。 [B] They are the most representative honor. 它们是最具代表性的荣誉。 [C] Their legitimacy has long been in dispute. 它们的合法性长期存在争议。 [D] Their endurance has done justice to them. 答案 D According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels?根据第4段，以下哪项对诺贝尔奖来说是正确的？ [A] History has never cast doubt on them.历史从未对他们有过质疑。 [B] They are the most representative honor.它们是最具代表性的荣誉。 [C] Their legitimacy has long been in dispute.它们的合法性长期存在争议。 [D] Their endurance has done justice to them. 💡 考场思路第四段末："Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy"——时间赋予了诺贝尔奖合法性。endurance = 时间的考验/持久。 逐项分析 [A] 历史从未怀疑 → 与原文"limit...has long been outgrown"不符； [B] 最具代表性荣誉 → 未提及； [C] 合法性长期受争议 → 与原文相反，时间已赋予其合法性； [D] 时间考验证明了其价值 → 正确，Time has given them legitimacy。

entries.title: The author believes that the new awards are ___.
entries.text: The author believes that the new awards are ___. [A] harmful to the culture of research. 有害于科研文化。 [B] acceptable despite the criticism. [C] subject to undesirable changes. 可能遭受不利的变化。 [D] unworthy of public attention. 不值得公众关注。 答案 B The author believes that the new awards are ___.作者认为，新的奖项是___。 [A] harmful to the culture of research.有害于科研文化。 [B] acceptable despite the criticism. [C] subject to undesirable changes.可能遭受不利的变化。 [D] unworthy of public attention.不值得公众关注。 💡 考场思路末段："It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace"——作者建议心怀感激地接受，即尽管有批评但可以接受。 逐项分析 [A] 有害研究文化 → 这是批评者的观点，作者不这么认为； [B] 尽管有批评仍可接受 → 正确； [C] 易受不良变化影响 → 无中生有； [D] 不值得公众关注 → 与"money and attention come to science is good"相反。 核心词汇 legitimacy n. 合法性 collaborative adj. 协作的 grace n. 优雅 distort v. 扭曲

entries.title: According to Paragraph 1, what is the author's attitude toward the AAAS's report
entries.text: According to Paragraph 1, what is the author's attitude toward the AAAS's report? [A] Critical. [B] Appreciative. 欣赏的；感激的。 [C] Contemptuous. 轻蔑的；鄙视的。 [D] Tolerant. 宽容的。 答案 A According to Paragraph 1, what is the author's attitude toward the AAAS's report?根据第1段，作者对AAAS报告的态度如何？ [A] Critical. [B] Appreciative.欣赏的；感激的。 [C] Contemptuous.轻蔑的；鄙视的。 [D] Tolerant.宽容的。 💡 考场思路第一段：先肯定 deserves praise，接着 "Regrettably...may cause more harm than good"——遗憾地、弊大于利，是批评态度。 逐项分析 [A] 批评的 → 正确，more harm than good 是批评； [B] 欣赏的 → 只看到前半句 deserves praise，忽略转折； [C] 蔑视的 → 程度过重，作者并非 contemptuous； [D] 宽容的 → 不符。 核心词汇 affirm v. 肯定 liberal democracy 自由民主 illiberal adj. 非自由的 presuppose v. 以……为前提 propaganda n. 宣传 set back 阻碍

entries.title: Influential figures in the Congress required that the AAAS report on how to ___.
entries.text: Influential figures in the Congress required that the AAAS report on how to ___. [A] safeguard individuals' rights to education. 保障个人的受教育权。 [B] define the government's role in education. 界定政府在教育中的角色。 [C] retain people's interest in liberal education. 保持人们对通识教育的兴趣。 [D] keep a leading position in liberal education. 答案 D Influential figures in the Congress required that the AAAS report on how to ___.国会中有影响力的人物要求AAAS报告如何___。 [A] safeguard individuals' rights to education.保障个人的受教育权。 [B] define the government's role in education.界定政府在教育中的角色。 [C] retain people's interest in liberal education.保持人们对通识教育的兴趣。 [D] keep a leading position in liberal education. 💡 考场思路第二段："maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education"——保持国家在人文社科教育领域的卓越地位。excellence = leading position。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests ___. [A] an exclusive study of American history. 一项专属的美国历史研究。 [B] a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects. 对理论学科更大的重视。 [C] the application of emerging technologies. [D] funding for the study of foreign languages. 外语研究的经费。 答案 C According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests ___.根据第3段，报告建议___。 [A] an exclusive study of American history.一项专属的美国历史研究。 [B] a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects.对理论学科更大的重视。 [C] the application of emerging technologies. [D] funding for the study of foreign languages.外语研究的经费。 💡 考场思路第三段："encourages the use of new digital technologies"——鼓励使用新数字技术，即应用新兴技术。 逐项分析 [A] 只研究美国历史 → 原文是 stresses the study of history...particularly American history，不是 exclusive； [B] 更强调理论学科 → 无中生有； [C] 应用新兴技术 → 正确； [D] 外语研究经费 → 原文是 greater study of foreign languages，不是 funding。

entries.title: The author implies in Paragraph 5 that professors are ___.
entries.text: The author implies in Paragraph 5 that professors are ___. [A] supportive of free markets. 支持自由市场。 [B] biased against classical liberal ideas. [C] cautious about intellectual investigation. 对智识探究持谨慎态度。 [D] conservative about public policy. 对公共政策持保守态度。 答案 B The author implies in Paragraph 5 that professors are ___.作者在第5段中暗示教授是___。 [A] supportive of free markets.支持自由市场。 [B] biased against classical liberal ideas. [C] cautious about intellectual investigation.对智识探究持谨慎态度。 [D] conservative about public policy.对公共政策持保守态度。 💡 考场思路第五段：教授们把保守或古典自由主义思想（自由市场、自立）描绘为"超出常规、不合法的研究范畴"——即对古典自由主义思想有偏见。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text? [A] Illiberal Education and "The Heart of the Matter". [B] The AAAS's Contribution to Liberal Education. AAAS对通识教育的贡献。 [C] Ways to Grasp "The Heart of the Matter". 把握“问题核心”的途径。 [D] Progressive Policy vs. Liberal Education. 进步政策 vs. 通识教育。 答案 A Which of the following would be the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Illiberal Education and "The Heart of the Matter". [B] The AAAS's Contribution to Liberal Education.AAAS对通识教育的贡献。 [C] Ways to Grasp "The Heart of the Matter".把握“问题核心”的途径。 [D] Progressive Policy vs. Liberal Education.进步政策 vs. 通识教育。 💡 考场思路全文围绕《问题的核心》报告展开，核心批评是"自由教育的非自由本质（illiberal nature of liberal education）"。 逐项分析 [A] 非自由教育与《问题的核心》 → 正确； [B] AAAS对自由教育的贡献 → 作者是批评态度，不是贡献； [C] 理解《问题的核心》的方法 → 偏离； [D] 进步政策 vs 自由教育 → 偏离核心。 核心词汇 citizenry n. 公民群体 curriculum n. 课程 enlighten v. 启发 obscure v. 掩盖

entries.title: 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。
entries.text: 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。 答案 C 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。 匹配依据A段首句"Some archaeological sites have always been easily observable"——但A段是已知位置。41在A之前。C段首句"How do archaeologists know where to find...when there is nothing visible on the surface?"——这是个总起问句，引出全文话题，且 C 段讲"survey and sample"，自然过渡到 A 段讲"有些遗址显眼"。 Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G ASome archaeological sites have always been easily observable—for example, the Parthenon in Athens, Greece; the pyramids of Giza in Egypt; and the megaliths of Stonehenge in southern England. But these sites are exceptions to the norm. Most archaeological sites have been located by means of careful searching, while many others have been discovered by accident. Olduvai Gorge, in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911. Thousands of Aztec artifacts came to light during the digging of the Mexico City subway in the 1970s.有些考古遗址

entries.title: 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。
entries.text: 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。 答案 F 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。 匹配依据A段末讲"many others discovered by accident（偶然发现）"。F段首句"Most archaeological sites, however, are discovered by archaeologists who have set out to look for them."——"however"转折，从偶然发现转到主动寻找（卡特找图坦卡蒙墓、伊文思找米诺斯宫殿），与A段形成对比。 Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G ASome archaeological sites have always been easily observable—for example, the Parthenon in Athens, Greece; the pyramids of Giza in Egypt; and the megaliths of Stonehenge in southern England. [A] tendency 倾向 [B] decision 决定 [C] arrangement 安排 [D] endeavor 努力 💡 考场思路"人们___与相似背景的人交朋友"——倾向。tendency to do。

entries.title: The findings do not simply explain people's 18 to befriend those of similar 19 b
entries.text: The findings do not simply explain people's 18 to befriend those of similar 19 backgrounds, say the researchers. [A] political 政治的 [B] religious 宗教的 [C] ethnic 族裔的 [D] economic 经济的 答案 C ethnic The findings do not simply explain people's 18 to befriend those of similar 19 backgrounds, say the researchers. Though all the subjects were drawn from a population of European extraction, care was taken to 20 that all subjects, friends and strangers, were taken from the same population. [A] political 政治的 [B] religious 宗教的 [C] ethnic 族裔的 [D] economic 经济的 💡 考场思路末句 European extraction（欧洲血统）对应 ethnic backgrounds（族裔背景）。

entries.title: Though all the subjects were drawn from a population of European extraction, car
entries.text: Though all the subjects were drawn from a population of European extraction, care was taken to 20 that all subjects, friends and strangers, were taken from the same population. [A] see (to it that) 确保 [B] show 展示 [C] prove 证明 [D] tell 告诉 答案 A see The findings do not simply explain people's 18 to befriend those of similar 19 backgrounds, say the researchers. Though all the subjects were drawn from a population of European extraction, care was taken to 20 that all subjects, friends and strangers, were taken from the same population. [A] see (to it that) 确保 [B] show 展示 [C] prove 证明 [D] tell 告诉 💡 考场思路see to it that = 确保，固定搭配。 ⚠️ 完形总结2015年完形主题：朋友间基因相似性研究。考点：固定搭配（conduct on / there is more to it / see to it that / tendency to）、近义动词辨析（conclude/compare/drive/resemble）、逻辑副词（Perhaps/also）。

entries.title: According to the first two paragraphs, King Juan Carlos of Spain ___.
entries.text: According to the first two paragraphs, King Juan Carlos of Spain ___. [A] used to enjoy high public support. 过去曾享有很高的公众支持。 [B] was unpopular among European royals. 在欧洲王室中不受欢迎。 [C] eased his relationship with his rivals. 缓解了他与对手的关系。 [D] ended his reign in embarrassment. 答案 D According to the first two paragraphs, King Juan Carlos of Spain ___.根据前两段，西班牙国王胡安·卡洛斯___。 [A] used to enjoy high public support.过去曾享有很高的公众支持。 [B] was unpopular among European royals.在欧洲王室中不受欢迎。 [C] eased his relationship with his rivals.缓解了他与对手的关系。 [D] ended his reign in embarrassment. 💡 考场思路第一段：embarrassing scandals 迫使他 eat his words and stand down——尴尬地退位。 逐项分析 [A] 曾受公众支持 → 无中生有； [B] 在欧洲王室中不受欢迎 → 未提及； [C] 缓和与对手关系 → 未提及； [D] 在尴尬中结束统治 → 正确，embarrassing scandals + stand down。 核心词汇 abdicate v. 退位 stand down 退位 polarised adj. 两极分化的 transcendence n. 超越 hierarchical adj. 等级制的 well-heeled adj. 富裕的

entries.title: Monarchs are kept as heads of state in Europe mostly ___.
entries.text: Monarchs are kept as heads of state in Europe mostly ___. [A] owing to their undoubted and respectable status. [B] to achieve a balance between tradition and reality. 在传统与现实间取得平衡。 [C] to give voters more public figures to look up to. 给选民提供更多可敬仰的公众人物。 [D] due to their everlasting political embodiment. 源于它们永恒的政治体现。 答案 A Monarchs are kept as heads of state in Europe mostly ___.在欧洲，君主被保留为国家元首，主要是___。 [A] owing to their undoubted and respectable status. [B] to achieve a balance between tradition and reality.在传统与现实间取得平衡。 [C] to give voters more public figures to look up to.给选民提供更多可敬仰的公众人物。 [D] due to their everlasting political embodiment.源于它们永恒的政治体现。 💡 考场思路第三段："they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure"——让选民不必寻找无争议但受尊敬的公众人物，即君主本身就是这样的人物。

entries.title: Which of the following is shown to be odd, according to Paragraph 4?
entries.text: Which of the following is shown to be odd, according to Paragraph 4? [A] Aristocrats' excessive reliance on inherited wealth. 贵族对继承财富的过度依赖。 [B] The role of the nobility in modern democracies. [C] The simple lifestyle of the aristocratic families. 贵族家庭的简朴生活方式。 [D] The nobility's adherence to their privileges. 贵族对其特权的固守。 答案 B Which of the following is shown to be odd, according to Paragraph 4?根据第4段，以下哪项显示为奇数？ [A] Aristocrats' excessive reliance on inherited wealth.贵族对继承财富的过度依赖。 [B] The role of the nobility in modern democracies. [C] The simple lifestyle of the aristocratic families.贵族家庭的简朴生活方式。 [D] The nobility's adherence to their privileges.贵族对其特权的固守。 💡 考场思路第四段末："it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states"——富裕贵族仍是现代民主国家的象征性核心，很荒谬。bizarre = odd。

entries.title: The British royals "have most to fear" because Charles ___.
entries.text: The British royals "have most to fear" because Charles ___. [A] takes a tough line on political issues. 在政治上持强硬路线。 [B] fails to change his lifestyle as advised. 未能按建议改变生活方式。 [C] takes republicans as his potential allies. 把共和党人视为潜在盟友。 [D] fails to adapt himself to his future role. 答案 D The British royals "have most to fear" because Charles ___.英国王室“最害怕” ，因为查尔斯___。 [A] takes a tough line on political issues.在政治上持强硬路线。 [B] fails to change his lifestyle as advised.未能按建议改变生活方式。 [C] takes republicans as his potential allies.把共和党人视为潜在盟友。 [D] fails to adapt himself to his future role. 💡 考场思路末段：查尔斯生活奢华、等级观念强、未能理解君主制的服务性质——即未能适应未来君主角色。

entries.title: Which of the following is the best title of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following is the best title of the text? [A] Carlos, Glory and Disgrace Combined. 卡洛斯：荣耀与耻辱交织。 [B] Charles, Anxious to Succeed to the Throne. 查尔斯：急于继承王位。 [C] Carlos, a Lesson for All European Monarchs. [D] Charles, Slow to React to the Coming Threats. 查尔斯对迫近的威胁反应迟缓。 答案 C Which of the following is the best title of the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Carlos, Glory and Disgrace Combined.卡洛斯：荣耀与耻辱交织。 [B] Charles, Anxious to Succeed to the Throne.查尔斯：急于继承王位。 [C] Carlos, a Lesson for All European Monarchs. [D] Charles, Slow to React to the Coming Threats.查尔斯对迫近的威胁反应迟缓。 💡 考场思路全文以卡洛斯退位为引子，讨论欧洲君主制的现状与危机，并特别警告英国王室。对应 [C]。 逐项分析 [A] 只讲卡洛斯个人 → 片面； [B] 查尔斯急于继位 → 偏离； [C] 卡洛斯给欧洲君主的教训 → 正确； [D] 查尔斯对威胁反应慢 → 片面。 核心词汇 indefensible adj. 站不住脚的 bizarre adj. 荒谬的 intrusiveness n. 侵扰 republican n. 共和主义者

entries.title: The Supreme Court will work out whether, during an arrest, it is legitimate to _
entries.text: The Supreme Court will work out whether, during an arrest, it is legitimate to ___. [A] search for suspects' mobile phones without a warrant. 在无搜查令的情况下搜查嫌疑人的手机。 [B] check suspects' phone contents without being authorized. [C] prevent suspects from deleting their phone contents. 防止嫌疑人删除手机内容。 [D] prohibit suspects from using their mobile phones. 禁止嫌疑人使用手机。 答案 B The Supreme Court will work out whether, during an arrest, it is legitimate to ___.最高法院将确定在逮捕期间， ___是否合法。 [A] search for suspects' mobile phones without a warrant.在无搜查令的情况下搜查嫌疑人的手机。 [B] check suspects' phone contents without being authorized. [C] prevent suspects from deleting their phone contents.防止嫌疑人删除手机内容。 [D] prohibit suspects from using their mobile phones.禁止嫌疑人使用手机。 💡 考场思路首段：whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant——没有授权检查手机内容是否合法。 逐项分析 [A] 寻找手机 → 原文是 search the contents（查看内容），不是寻找手机； [B] 未经授权查看手机内容 → 正确； [C] 阻止删除 → 未提及； [D] 禁止使用 → 未提及。 核心词汇 warrant n. 搜查令 sweeping ruling 一刀切裁决 discernable adj. 可辨别的 invalid v. 使无效 disruptive adj. 颠覆性的 Fourth Amendment 第四修正案

entries.title: The author's attitude toward California's argument is one of ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude toward California's argument is one of ___. [A] tolerance. 宽容；容忍。 [B] indifference. 冷漠；漠不关心。 [C] disapproval. [D] cautiousness. 谨慎。 答案 C The author's attitude toward California's argument is one of ___.作者对加利福尼亚州的论点的态度是___之一。 [A] tolerance.宽容；容忍。 [B] indifference.冷漠；漠不关心。 [C] disapproval. [D] cautiousness.谨慎。 💡 考场思路作者称加州论点"lame（站不住脚）"、"recklessly modest"、"should not swallow"——明确反对。

entries.title: The author believes that exploring one's phone contents is comparable to ___.
entries.text: The author believes that exploring one's phone contents is comparable to ___. [A] getting into one's residence. [B] handling one's historical records. 处理个人的历史记录。 [C] scanning one's correspondences. 扫描某人的往来信件。 [D] going through one's wallet. 翻看某人的钱包。 答案 A The author believes that exploring one's phone contents is comparable to ___.作者认为，探索自己的手机内容与___相当。 [A] getting into one's residence. [B] handling one's historical records.处理个人的历史记录。 [C] scanning one's correspondences.扫描某人的往来信件。 [D] going through one's wallet.翻看某人的钱包。 💡 考场思路第四段："exploring one's smartphone is more like entering his or her home"——进入家 = 进入住所。

entries.title: In Paragraphs 5 and 6, the author shows his concern that ___.
entries.text: In Paragraphs 5 and 6, the author shows his concern that ___. [A] principles are hard to be clearly expressed. 原则难以被清晰表述。 [B] the court is giving police less room for action. 法院给予警方的行动空间更小。 [C] phones are used to store sensitive information. 手机被用来存储敏感信息。 [D] citizens' privacy is not effectively protected. 答案 D In Paragraphs 5 and 6, the author shows his concern that ___.在第5段和第6段，作者表示担心___。 [A] principles are hard to be clearly expressed.原则难以被清晰表述。 [B] the court is giving police less room for action.法院给予警方的行动空间更小。 [C] phones are used to store sensitive information.手机被用来存储敏感信息。 [D] citizens' privacy is not effectively protected. 💡 考场思路第五段：citizens have a right to expect private documents to remain private；第六段：line-drawing 困难——作者担心隐私得不到有效保护。

entries.title: Orin Kerr's comparison is quoted to indicate that ___.
entries.text: Orin Kerr's comparison is quoted to indicate that ___. [A] the Constitution should be implemented flexibly. 宪法应被灵活执行。 [B] new technology requires reinterpretation of the Constitution. [C] California's argument violates principles of the Constitution. 加州的论点违背宪法原则。 [D] principles of the Constitution should never be altered. 宪法原则绝不应被更改。 答案 B Orin Kerr's comparison is quoted to indicate that ___.引用奥林·克尔的比较是为了表明___。 [A] the Constitution should be implemented flexibly.宪法应被灵活执行。 [B] new technology requires reinterpretation of the Constitution. [C] California's argument violates principles of the Constitution.加州的论点违背宪法原则。 [D] principles of the Constitution should never be altered.宪法原则绝不应被更改。 💡 考场思路末段论点："New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections"——新技术要求宪法做出新的应用/解读。 核心词汇 line-drawing n. 划定界限 sort out 理清 swallow whole 全盘接受 entitlement n. 权利

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that ___. [A] Science intends to simplify its peer-review process. 科学界意在简化其同行评审流程。 [B] journals are strengthening their statistical checks. [C] few journals are blamed for mistakes in data analysis. 很少有期刊因数据分析错误而受责。 [D] lack of data analysis is common in research projects. 缺乏数据分析在研究项目中很常见。 答案 B It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that ___.从第1款中可以了解到___。 [A] Science intends to simplify its peer-review process.科学界意在简化其同行评审流程。 [B] journals are strengthening their statistical checks. [C] few journals are blamed for mistakes in data analysis.很少有期刊因数据分析错误而受责。 [D] lack of data analysis is common in research projects.缺乏数据分析在研究项目中很常见。 💡 考场思路首段：adding an extra round of statistical checks + similar efforts from other journals——期刊正在加强统计审查。 逐项分析 [A] 简化同行评审 → 与 extra round 相反； [B] 期刊加强统计审查 → 正确； [C] 很少期刊被指责 → 与 widespread concern 相反； [D] 缺乏数据分析 → 原文是 mistakes in data analysis，不是 lack。 核心词汇 peer-review n. 同行评审 irreproducibility n. 不可重复性 manuscript n. 稿件 scrutiny n. 审查 overdue adj. 早该发生的 methodology n. 方法论

entries.title: The phrase "flagged up" (Para. 2) is the closest in meaning to ___.
entries.text: The phrase "flagged up" (Para. 2) is the closest in meaning to ___. [A] found. 建立；发现。 [B] revised. 修订过的；修改的。 [C] marked. [D] stored. 被储存的。 答案 C The phrase "flagged up" (Para. 2) is the closest in meaning to ___.短语“标记” （第2段）的含义最接近___。 [A] found.建立；发现。 [B] revised.修订过的；修改的。 [C] marked. [D] stored.被储存的。 💡 考场思路"Manuscript will be flagged up for additional scrutiny"——稿件被标记出来以接受额外审查。flag up = 标记。

entries.title: Giovanni Parmigiani believes that the establishment of the SBoRE may ___.
entries.text: Giovanni Parmigiani believes that the establishment of the SBoRE may ___. [A] pose a threat to all its peers. 对所有同行构成威胁。 [B] meet with strong opposition. 遭遇强烈反对。 [C] increase Science's circulation. 增加《科学》的发行量。 [D] set an example for other journals. 答案 D Giovanni Parmigiani believes that the establishment of the SBoRE may ___.Giovanni Parmigiani认为， SBoRE的建立可能___。 [A] pose a threat to all its peers.对所有同行构成威胁。 [B] meet with strong opposition.遭遇强烈反对。 [C] increase Science's circulation.增加《科学》的发行量。 [D] set an example for other journals. 💡 考场思路第四段："a larger group of publishing places that may want to model their approach after Science"——其他出版机构可能效仿《科学》，即树立榜样。

entries.title: David Vaux holds that what Science is doing now ___.
entries.text: David Vaux holds that what Science is doing now ___. [A] adds to researchers' workload. 增加了研究者的工作负担。 [B] diminishes the role of reviewers. 削弱了评审者的角色。 [C] has room for further improvement. [D] is to fail in the foreseeable future. 将在可预见的未来失败。 答案 C David Vaux holds that what Science is doing now ___.大卫·沃克斯（ David Vaux ）认为，科学现在正在做的是___。 [A] adds to researchers' workload.增加了研究者的工作负担。 [B] diminishes the role of reviewers.削弱了评审者的角色。 [C] has room for further improvement. [D] is to fail in the foreseeable future.将在可预见的未来失败。 💡 考场思路末段："has some merit, but a weakness is..."——有优点但也有弱点，即还有改进空间。

entries.title: Which of the following is the best title of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following is the best title of the text? [A] Science Joins Push to Screen Statistics in Papers. [B] Professional Statisticians Deserve More Respect. 专业统计学家理应更受尊重。 [C] Data Analysis Finds Its Way onto Editors' Desks. 数据分析登上编辑的案头。 [D] Statisticians Are Coming Back with Science. 统计学家带着科学卷土重来。 答案 A Which of the following is the best title of the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Science Joins Push to Screen Statistics in Papers. [B] Professional Statisticians Deserve More Respect.专业统计学家理应更受尊重。 [C] Data Analysis Finds Its Way onto Editors' Desks.数据分析登上编辑的案头。 [D] Statisticians Are Coming Back with Science.统计学家带着科学卷土重来。 💡 考场思路全文围绕《科学》杂志增加统计审查这一事件展开。 逐项分析 [A] 《科学》加入论文统计审查浪潮 → 正确； [B] 统计学家值得更多尊重 → 偏离； [C] 数据分析登上编辑桌面 → 不具体； [D] 统计学家随《科学》回归 → 比喻不当。 核心词汇 advisory role 咨询角色 foresight n. 远见 model after 效仿 take a tougher line 采取更强硬立场

entries.title: According to the first two paragraphs, Elisabeth was upset by ___.
entries.text: According to the first two paragraphs, Elisabeth was upset by ___. [A] the consequences of the current sorting mechanism. [B] companies' financial loss due to immoral practices. 企业因不道德行为所致的财务损失。 [C] governmental ineffectiveness on moral issues. 政府在道德议题上的无力。 [D] the wide misuse of integrity among institutions. 各机构对诚信的广泛滥用。 答案 A According to the first two paragraphs, Elisabeth was upset by ___.根据前两段，伊丽莎白对___感到不安。 [A] the consequences of the current sorting mechanism. [B] companies' financial loss due to immoral practices.企业因不道德行为所致的财务损失。 [C] governmental ineffectiveness on moral issues.政府在道德议题上的无力。 [D] the wide misuse of integrity among institutions.各机构对诚信的广泛滥用。 💡 考场思路第一段：the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market——她不满的是把利润和市场作为唯一分选机制所带来的后果（诚信缺失）。 逐项分析 [A] 当前分选机制的后果 → 正确； [B] 不道德行为导致的财务损失 → 未提及； [C] 政府在道德问题上的无能 → 片面； [D] 机构对诚信的广泛滥用 → 她讲的是 dearth（缺失），不是 misuse（滥用）。 核心词汇 dearth n. 缺乏 integrity n. 诚信 sorting mechanism 分选机制 conspire v. 合谋 accountable adj. 负责的 doctrine n. 信条

entries.title: It can be inferred from Paragraph 3 that ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 3 that ___. [A] Glenn Mulcaire may deny phone hacking as a crime. Glenn Mulcaire可能否认电话窃听构成犯罪。 [B] phone hacking will be accepted on certain occasions. 电话窃听在某些情况下会被接受。 [C] Andy Coulson should be held innocent of the charge. Andy Coulson应被判无罪。 [D] more journalists may be found guilty of phone hacking. 答案 D It can be inferred from Paragraph 3 that ___.从第3款可以推断出___。 [A] Glenn Mulcaire may deny phone hacking as a crime.Glenn Mulcaire可能否认电话窃听构成犯罪。 [B] phone hacking will be accepted on certain occasions.电话窃听在某些情况下会被接受。 [C] Andy Coulson should be held innocent of the charge.Andy Coulson应被判无罪。 [D] more journalists may be found guilty of phone hacking. 💡 考场思路第三段："Others await trial. This long story still unfolds"——其他人还在等审判，事件仍在展开，暗示更多记者会被判有罪。

entries.title: The author believes that Rebekah Brooks's defence ___.
entries.text: The author believes that Rebekah Brooks's defence ___. [A] revealed a cunning personality. 暴露出一种狡黠的个性。 [B] centered on trivial issues. 聚焦于琐碎问题。 [C] was hardly convincing. [D] was part of a conspiracy. 是某阴谋的一部分。 答案 C The author believes that Rebekah Brooks's defence ___.提交人认为Rebekah Brooks的辩护___。 [A] revealed a cunning personality.暴露出一种狡黠的个性。 [B] centered on trivial issues.聚焦于琐碎问题。 [C] was hardly convincing. [D] was part of a conspiracy.是某阴谋的一部分。 💡 考场思路第四段："One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew..."——她的"我一无所知"辩护令人震惊，即难以令人信服。

entries.title: The author holds that the current collective doctrine shows ___.
entries.text: The author holds that the current collective doctrine shows ___. [A] generally distorted values. [B] unfair wealth distribution. 不公平的财富分配。 [C] a marginalized lifestyle. 一种被边缘化的生活方式。 [D] a rigid moral code. 一套僵化的道德准则。 答案 A The author holds that the current collective doctrine shows ___.作者认为，目前的集体教义显示___。 [A] generally distorted values. [B] unfair wealth distribution.不公平的财富分配。 [C] a marginalized lifestyle.一种被边缘化的生活方式。 [D] a rigid moral code.一套僵化的道德准则。 💡 考场思路第五段：重要词汇都是效率、股东价值等，而正义、公平、宽容被边缘化——即集体信条是扭曲的价值观。

entries.title: Which of the following is suggested in the last paragraph?
entries.text: Which of the following is suggested in the last paragraph? [A] The quality of writings is of primary importance. 写作的质量至关重要。 [B] Moral awareness matters in editing a newspaper. [C] Common humanity is central to news reporting. 共同人性是新闻报道的核心。 [D] Journalists need stricter industrial regulations. 记者需要更严格的行业监管。 答案 B Which of the following is suggested in the last paragraph?最后一段提出了以下哪项？ [A] The quality of writings is of primary importance.写作的质量至关重要。 [B] Moral awareness matters in editing a newspaper. [C] Common humanity is central to news reporting.共同人性是新闻报道的核心。 [D] Journalists need stricter industrial regulations.记者需要更严格的行业监管。 💡 考场思路末段：《世界新闻报》的编辑目的不是公正、人性，而是追求发行量——暗示编辑报纸时道德意识很重要。 核心词汇 proportionality n. 相称性 traceable adj. 可追溯的 betray v. 流露/背叛 quest n. 追求

entries.title: This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of
entries.text: This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent. This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent. 在各种强大动机的推动下，这场迁移从荒野中造就了一个民族，并循其本质塑造了一片全新大陆的特点，决定了它的命运。 采分点① driven by... 由……推动；② built a nation out of a wilderness 从荒野中造就民族；③ uncharted continent 未知大陆。

entries.title: The United States is the product of two principal forces—the immigration of Euro
entries.text: The United States is the product of two principal forces—the immigration of European peoples with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics and the impact of a new country which modified these traits. The United States is the product of two principal forces—the immigration of European peoples with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics and the impact of a new country which modified these traits. 合众国是两股主要力量作用的产物：一是具有不同思想、风俗和民族特点的欧洲各民族的迁入；二是一个新国家因改变了这些特征而产生的影响。 采分点① principal forces 主要力量；② varied ideas, customs 不同思想风俗；③ modified these traits 改变了这些特征。

entries.text: But the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America, the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another, and the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent caused significant changes. But the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America, the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another, and the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent caused significant changes. 但美洲特有地理条件的作用，不同族裔间的相互影响，加上在一片蛮荒新大陆上维持旧大陆方式的巨大困难，所有这一切引起了意义深远的变化。 采分点① peculiar to 特有的；② interplay 相互作用；③ sheer difficulty 巨大困难；④ raw, new continent 蛮荒新大陆。

The first shiploads of immigrants bound for the territory which is now the United States crossed the Atlantic more than a hundred years after the 15th-and-16th-century explorations of North America. 在15、16世纪的北美大陆探险过去一百多年后，首批满载移民驶向今天合众国这片疆土的船只横穿过了大西洋。 采分点① shiploads of 满载……的船；② bound for 驶向；③ territory 领土。

entries.title: Suppose you are the host of a club reading session. Write an email of about 100
entries.text: Suppose you are the host of a club reading session. Write an email of about 100 words to the club members to recommend a book and explain your reasons. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 推荐信 原题指令 Directions Suppose you are the host of a club reading session. Write an email of about 100 words to the club members to recommend a book and explain your reasons. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. 【译文】假设你是读书会的主持人。写一封约100词的电子邮件，向俱乐部成员推荐一本书并说明原因。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。 题目 你将主持一次俱乐部读书会。写一封约100词的邮件，向俱乐部成员推荐一本书。说明推荐理由。落款 Li Ming。 审题 ① 格式：邮件；② 语气：热情友好；③ 内容：书名+2-3条推荐理由。 参考范文 Dear Club Members, I am writing to recommend a book for our next reading session: The Old Man and the Sea by Ernest Hemingway. I recommend it for three reasons. First, it is a concise yet profound novella that can be finished within a few hours. Second, Hemingway's distinctive "iceberg" style leaves much to discuss in terms of language and symbolism. Finally, the story of the old fisherman's struggle against a giant marlin conveys a timeless spirit of perseverance that inspires every reader. I hope you will enjoy reading it. Yours sincerely, Li Ming 【译文】 各位书友： 我写信是想为咱们下期的读书会推荐一本书：欧内斯特·海明威

You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The picture shows four people sitting around a dinner table full of dishes, but each is bowing over his or her mobile phone, with no communication at all. The caption reads: "A gathering in the mobile-phone era". Part B 大作文（20分）— 图画作文《手机时代的聚会》 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The picture shows four people sitting around a dinner table full of dishes, but each is bowing over his or her mobile phone, with no communication at all. The caption reads: "A gathering in the mobile-phone era". 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 四个人围坐在餐桌旁，面前摆满菜肴，但每个人都低头盯着自己的手机，彼此毫无交流。图题：手机时代的聚会。 图画描述 四个人围坐在餐桌旁，面前摆满菜肴，但每个人都低头盯着自己的手机，彼此毫无交流。图题：手机时代的聚会。 审题框架 三段式：①简要描述图画；②阐释含义（手机削弱了面对面交流、人情冷漠）；③给出评论（合理使用手机、重视面对面沟通）。160-200词。 参考范文 The cartoon depicts four people seated around a dinner table laden with food, yet each is bowing their head over a smartphone, exchanging no words with one another. The caption reads: a party in the age of mobile phones. The drawing reveals a common malady of modern life: while mobile phones bring us unprecedented convenience, they are quietly alienating us from those around us. Many young people stare at screens even during family dinners or gatherings with friends, treating physical companionship as mere background noise. entries.title: According to the first paragraph, what would happen in France?
entries.text: According to the first paragraph, what would happen in France? [A] Physical beauty would be redefined. [B] New runways would be constructed. 将修建新的跑道。 [C] Websites about dieting would thrive. 减肥类网站会兴盛。 [D] The fashion industry would decline. 时装业将会衰退。 答案 A According to the first paragraph, what would happen in France?根据第一段，法国会发生什么？ [A] Physical beauty would be redefined. [B] New runways would be constructed.将修建新的跑道。 [C] Websites about dieting would thrive.减肥类网站会兴盛。 [D] The fashion industry would decline.时装业将会衰退。 💡 考场思路首段：fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women——时尚业不再能定义美，即形体美将被重新定义。 逐项分析 [A] 形体美将被重新定义 → 正确； [B] 新建T台 → 无中生有； [C] 节食网站繁荣 → 与 ban websites 相反； [D] 时尚业衰退 → 过度推断。 核心词汇 preliminary adj. 初步的 incite v. 煽动 impinge on 损害 arbiter n. 评判者 intangible adj. 无形的 sanction n. 制裁

[C] Models are no longer under peer pressure.模特不再受制于同侪压力。 [D] Its inherent problems are getting worse.其固有问题正愈发严重。 💡 考场思路第六段：丹麦时尚业 agreed last month on rules and sanctions——丹麦正在制定新标准。

entries.text: A designer is most likely to be rejected by CFW for ___. [D] setting a high age threshold for models. 为模特设定较高的年龄门槛。 答案 C A designer is most likely to be rejected by CFW for ___.设计师最有可能因___被CFW拒绝。 [A] pursuing perfect physical conditions.追求完美的身体状况。 [B] caring too much about models' character.过分在意模特的品格。 [C] showing little concern for health factors. [D] setting a high age threshold for models.为模特设定较高的年龄门槛。 💡 考场思路CFW拒绝的是违反《时尚道德宪章》的设计师，宪章要求关注模特健康——即不关心健康因素的设计师会被拒。

entries.title: Britain's public sentiment about the countryside ___.
entries.text: Britain's public sentiment about the countryside ___. [A] has brought much benefit to the NHS. 已为英国国民医疗体系（NHS）带来诸多益处。 [B] didn't start till the Shakespearean age. 直到莎士比亚时代才开始。 [C] is fully backed by the royal family. 得到王室全力支持。 [D] is not well reflected in politics. 答案 D Britain's public sentiment about the countryside ___.英国公众对乡村的看法___。 [A] has brought much benefit to the NHS.已为英国国民医疗体系（NHS）带来诸多益处。 [B] didn't start till the Shakespearean age.直到莎士比亚时代才开始。 [C] is fully backed by the royal family.得到王室全力支持。 [D] is not well reflected in politics. 💡 考场思路首段末：this has limited political support——对乡村的自豪感在政治上支持有限，即没有很好地反映在政治中。 逐项分析 [A] 给NHS带来好处 → 并列关系，不是因果； [B] 始于莎士比亚时代 → 无中生有； [C] 王室全力支持 → 无中生有； [D] 在政治中反映不足 → 正确。 核心词汇 endorsement n. 支持 guardianship n. 守护 infrastructure n. 基础设施 renovation n. 改造 coherent adj. 连贯的 spectrum n. 光谱/范围

[B] effectively reinforced.得到有效强化。 [C] properly protected.得到妥善保护。 [D] largely overshadowed.在很大程度上被遮蔽。 💡 考场思路第二段：concrete consumes more of it——混凝土在吞噬乡村，即国民信托的成果正被逐渐破坏。

entries.title: Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3?
entries.text: Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3? [A] Labour is under attack for opposing development. 工党因反对开发而受到抨击。 [B] The Conservatives may abandon "off-plan" building. 保守党可能放弃“期房”建设。 [C] Ukip may gain from its support for rural conservation. [D] The Liberal Democrats are losing political influence. 自由民主党正失去政治影响力。 答案 C Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3?从第3款中可以推断出以下哪项？ [A] Labour is under attack for opposing development.工党因反对开发而受到抨击。 [B] The Conservatives may abandon "off-plan" building.保守党可能放弃“期房”建设。 [C] Ukip may gain from its support for rural conservation. [D] The Liberal Democrats are losing political influence.自由民主党正失去政治影响力。 💡 考场思路第三段：Only Ukip, sensing its chance, has sided with those pleading for...——独立党嗅到机会站到保护乡村一边，暗示它可能从中获益。

entries.title: The author holds that George Osborne's preference ___.
entries.text: The author holds that George Osborne's preference ___. [A] reveals a strong prejudice against urban areas. 流露出对城市地区的强烈偏见。 [B] shows his disregard for the character of rural areas. [C] stresses the necessity of easing the housing crisis. 强调缓解住房危机的必要性。 [D] highlights his firm stand against lobby pressure. 凸显了他抵制游说压力的坚定立场。 答案 B The author holds that George Osborne's preference ___.作者认为乔治·奥斯本的偏好___。 [A] reveals a strong prejudice against urban areas.流露出对城市地区的强烈偏见。 [B] shows his disregard for the character of rural areas. [C] stresses the necessity of easing the housing crisis.强调缓解住房危机的必要性。 [D] highlights his firm stand against lobby pressure.凸显了他抵制游说压力的坚定立场。 💡 考场思路第五段：奥斯本偏好乡村新建，而作者认为乡村发展应"stick to their edges and respect their character"——即奥斯本不尊重乡村特色。

[D] the political life in today's Britain. 当今英国的政治生活。 答案 C In the last paragraph, the author shows his appreciation of ___.在最后一段中，作者对___表示感谢。 [A] the size of population in Britain.英国的人口规模。 [B] the enviable urban lifestyle in Britain.英国令人羡慕的城市生活方式。 [C] the town-and-country planning in Britain. [D] the political life in today's Britain.当今英国的政治生活。 💡 考场思路末段：Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence——作者赞赏英国城乡规划。 核心词汇 let rip 放任自流 corrupted adj. 被破坏的 biased adj. 有偏向的 lobby n. 游说集团

entries.title: The author views Milton Friedman's statement about CSR with ___.
entries.text: The author views Milton Friedman's statement about CSR with ___. [A] uncertainty. 不确定性。 [B] skepticism. [C] approval. 批准；赞成。 [D] tolerance. 宽容。 答案 B The author views Milton Friedman's statement about CSR with ___.作者将米尔顿·弗里德曼（ Milton Friedman ）关于企业社会责任的陈述与___一起查看。 [A] uncertainty.不确定性。 [B] skepticism. [C] approval.批准；赞成。 [D] tolerance.宽容。 💡 考场思路首段：even if you accept Friedman's premise...things may not be absolutely clear-cut——作者用 but 转折，暗示对弗里德曼观点的怀疑。 逐项分析 [A] 不确定 → 不是； [B] 怀疑 → 正确； [C] 赞同 → 与 but 相反； [D] 宽容 → 不符。 核心词汇 premise n. 前提 clear-cut adj. 绝对的 halo effect 光环效应 lenient adj. 宽大的 prosecute v. 起诉 bank on 指望

entries.text: According to Paragraph 2, CSR helps a company by ___. [A] guarding it against malpractices. 防范其舞弊行为。 [B] protecting it from being defamed. 保护它免受诽谤。 [C] winning trust from consumers. [D] raising the quality of its products.提升其产品质量。 💡 考场思路第二段三种方式：信号、间接捐款、光环效应——都归结为赢得消费者信任。

entries.text: The expression "more lenient" (Para. 4) is closest in meaning to ___. [A] less controversial. 争议较小的。 [B] more lasting. 更持久的。 [C] more effective. 更有效的。 [D] less severe. 答案 D The expression "more lenient" (Para. 4) is closest in meaning to ___.“更宽大” （第4段）在含义上最接近___。 [A] less controversial.争议较小的。 [B] more lasting.更持久的。 [C] more effective.更有效的。 [D] less severe. 💡 考场思路CSR全面的企业处罚更"宽大"——lenient = less severe（不那么严厉）。

entries.title: When prosecutors evaluate a case, a company's CSR record ___.
entries.text: When prosecutors evaluate a case, a company's CSR record ___. [A] comes across as reliable evidence. 看起来像是可靠的证据。 [B] has an impact on their decision. [C] increases the chance of being penalized. 增加了受处罚的几率。 [D] constitutes part of the investigation. 构成调查的一部分。 答案 B When prosecutors evaluate a case, a company's CSR record ___.当检察官评估案件时，公司的CSR记录___。 [A] comes across as reliable evidence.看起来像是可靠的证据。 [B] has an impact on their decision. [C] increases the chance of being penalized.增加了受处罚的几率。 [D] constitutes part of the investigation.构成调查的一部分。 💡 考场思路第五段：prosecutors do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR——CSR记录影响检察官决定。

entries.title: The New York Times is considering ending its print edition partly due to ___.
entries.text: The New York Times is considering ending its print edition partly due to ___. [A] the increasing online ad sales. 日益增长的在线广告销售额。 [B] the pressure from its investors. 来自其投资者的压力。 [C] the complaints from its readers. 来自读者的投诉。 [D] the high cost of operation. 答案 D The New York Times is considering ending its print edition partly due to ___.《纽约时报》正在考虑结束其印刷版，部分原因是___。 [A] the increasing online ad sales.日益增长的在线广告销售额。 [B] the pressure from its investors.来自其投资者的压力。 [C] the complaints from its readers.来自读者的投诉。 [D] the high cost of operation. 💡 考场思路第二段：infrastructure isn't just expensive; it's excessive——运营成本高。 逐项分析 [A] 线上广告增长 → 原文 print ad sales still dwarf online，不是原因； [B] 投资者压力 → 未提及； [C] 读者抱怨 → 相反，忠实读者会不满； [D] 运营成本高 → 正确。 核心词汇 cease v. 停止 nostalgia n. 怀旧 ditch v. 抛弃 infrastructure n. 基础设施 circulation n. 发行量 foresighted adj. 有远见的

entries.title: We don't have to learn how to be mentally healthy; it is built into us in the sa
entries.text: We don't have to learn how to be mentally healthy; it is built into us in the same way that our bodies know how to heal a cut or mend a broken bone. We don't have to learn how to be mentally healthy; it is built into us in the same way that our bodies know how to heal a cut or mend a broken bone. 我们的心理健康不是学来的；它是我们生来就有的，正如同我们的身体知道如何愈合伤口或修复断骨一样。 采分点① be built into us 内置于我们/天生具有；② heal a cut 愈合伤口；③ mend a broken bone 修复断骨。

entries.title: Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it ca
entries.text: Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant. Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant. 心理健康并没有真的离开；宛如云朵后面的太阳，它虽然可能暂离我们的视线，但完全能在转瞬之间重现。 采分点① temporarily hidden 暂时被遮蔽；② be capable of 能够；③ in an instant 瞬间。

entries.title: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles
entries.text: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain, and with unconditional love no matter who they are. Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain, and with unconditional love no matter who they are. 健康的心理让我们在他人遇到困难时心怀同情，遭受苦痛时心怀善意，不论他们是谁都心怀无条件的爱。 采分点① view others with sympathy 以同情看待他人；② unconditional love 无条件的爱。

entries.title: Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ord
entries.text: Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ordinary as you will see that it has been there to direct you through all your difficult decisions. Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ordinary as you will see that it has been there to direct you through all your difficult decisions. 尽管心理健康是我们生活的万能良药，但它又再寻常不过，因为你会发现，它一直在那里引领你完成所有艰难的抉择。 采分点① cure-all 万灵药；② perfectly ordinary 再寻常不过；③ direct you through 引领你度过。

entries.title: As you will come to see, knowing that mental health is always available and know
entries.text: As you will come to see, knowing that mental health is always available and knowing to trust it allow us to slow down to the moment and live life happily. As you will come to see, knowing that mental health is always available and knowing to trust it allow us to slow down to the moment and live life happily. 你终会明白，懂得心理健康无时不在并懂得信赖它，这能让我们慢下来活在每一刻，快乐地生活着。 采分点① available 可获得的/存在的；② slow down to the moment 慢下来活在当下；③ live life happily 快乐地生活。

To help you make the most of the library, here is some essential information for new international students. The library is open from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. on weekdays and from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. on weekends. Each student may borrow up to five books for 30 days. With your student ID, you can also access our online databases and e-journals 24 hours a day. A free orientation session will be held in the main hall next Monday at 2:00 p.m. We look forward to seeing you in the library! Li MingThe Library 【译文】 通知 欢迎来到我们大学！为帮助新入学的国际学生充分利用图书馆，以下提供若干重要信息。 图书馆

[C] highlight the necessity of upgrading major U.S. airports.凸显升级美国主要机场的必要性。 [D] emphasize the importance of privacy protection.强调隐私保护的重要性。 💡 考场思路例证题看论点。前句：Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety——埃及航空坠毁事件解释了美国人为何容忍安检。 逐项分析 [A] 强调全球加强安全紧迫性 → 过度拔高； [B] 解释美国人对安检的容忍 → 正确； [C] 强调升级美国机场必要性 → 偏离； [D] 强调隐私保护 → 无中生有。 核心词汇 undermine v. 削弱 infuriating adj. 令人愤怒的 sneak v. 偷偷带过 anticipate v. 预料 eligible adj. 有资格的 sticker shock 价格冲击

entries.title: Queen Liliuokalani's remark in Paragraph 1 indicates ___.
entries.text: Queen Liliuokalani's remark in Paragraph 1 indicates ___. [A] the importance of astronomy in ancient Hawaiian society. [B] her conservative view on the historical role of astronomy. 她对天文学历史角色的保守看法。 [C] the regrettable decline of astronomy in ancient times. 古代天文学令人遗憾的衰落。 [D] her appreciation of star watchers' feats in her time. 她对那个时代观星者功绩的赞赏。 答案 A Queen Liliuokalani's remark in Paragraph 1 indicates ___.Liliuokalani女王在第1段中的评论表明___。 [A] the importance of astronomy in ancient Hawaiian society. [B] her conservative view on the historical role of astronomy.她对天文学历史角色的保守看法。 [C] the regrettable decline of astronomy in ancient times.古代天文学令人遗憾的衰落。 [D] her appreciation of star watchers' feats in her time.她对那个时代观星者功绩的赞赏。 💡 考场思路首段："古代夏威夷人是天文学家" + "观星者是最受尊敬的成员"——说明天文学在古夏威夷社会的重要性。 逐项分析 [A] 古夏威夷社会中天文学的重要性 → 正确； [B] 对天文学历史角色的保守观点 → 未提及； [C] 古代天文学的衰落 → 与原文相反； [D] 赞赏她那个时代观星者的功绩 → 原文讲古代，不是她那个时代。 核心词汇 dormant adj. 休眠的 sovereign adj. 主权的 fragile adj. 脆弱的 renaissance n. 复兴 compromise n. 妥协 archeological adj. 考古的
